const svg=(id,cls='')=>`<svg class="${cls}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${icons[id]||icons.arrow}</svg>`;
const image=(i,cls='')=>`<img class="${cls}" src="${asset(`assets/original-${i}.${i===3?'webp':i>=14&&i!==17?'jpg':'png'}`)}" alt="" aria-hidden="true">`;

const vetoraIcon=(id,cls='')=>`<img class="${cls}" src="${asset('assets/vetora-library/'+id+'.png')}" alt="" aria-hidden="true" loading="lazy" decoding="async">`;
const medicalAssetMap=Object.freeze({
  therapy:'therapy',surgery:'surgery',diagnostic:'ultrasound',dental:'dentistry',
  dermatology:'dermatology',cardiology:'cardiology',vaccination:'vaccination',
  ophthalmology:'ophthalmology',neurology:'neurology',oncology:'oncology',
  orthopedics:'traumatology',all:'general_care'
});
const medicalIcon=(id,cls='')=>vetoraIcon(medicalAssetMap[id]||'general_care',cls);
const mobileNavIcon=Object.freeze({home:'home',clinics:'clinic',doctors:'veterinarian',services:'medical_conclusion'});
const sectionIconMap=Object.freeze({
  'Популярные специалисты':'specialist','Популярные услуги':'medical_conclusion',
  'Услуги и цены':'invoice','Специалисты клиники':'veterinarian',
  'Направления':'general_care','Ветаптеки':'clinic'
});
function serviceIconId(s){
  const t=normalize((s.id||'')+' '+(s.title||''));
  if(/узи|ультразвук|ultrasound|abdomen/.test(t))return 'ultrasound';
  if(/рентген|radiol|x-ray/.test(t))return 'radiology';
  if(/вакцин|привив|vaccin/.test(t))return 'vaccination';
  if(/чипир|микрочип|microchip/.test(t))return 'pet_passport';
  if(/стомат|зуб|dental/.test(t))return 'dentistry';
  if(/лаборатор|анализ|кров/.test(t))return 'lab_tests';
  if(/стерилиз|кастрац|операц|хирург/.test(t))return 'surgery';
  if(/осмотр|прием|checkup/.test(t))return 'general_care';
  const k={therapy:'therapy',surgery:'surgery',diagnostic:'diagnostics',
    dental:'dentistry',dermatology:'dermatology',cardiology:'cardiology',
    vaccination:'vaccination',ophthalmology:'ophthalmology',neurology:'neurology',
    oncology:'oncology',orthopedics:'traumatology'};
  return k[s.category]||'general_care';
}
const categoryList=[['therapy','Терапия'],['surgery','Хирургия'],['diagnostic','УЗИ и диагностика'],['dental','Стоматология'],['dermatology','Дерматология'],['cardiology','Кардиология'],['vaccination','Вакцинация'],['ophthalmology','Офтальмология'],['neurology','Неврология'],['oncology','Онкология'],['orthopedics','Травматология'],['all','Все направления']];
categoryList.push(...[
 ['radiology','Рентген'],['dietetics','Диетология'],['traumatology','Травматология'],
 ['pulmonology','Пульмонология'],['reproduction','Репродукция'],['endosurgery','Эндохирургия'],
 ['endocrinology','Эндокринология'],['intensive','Реанимация и интенсивная терапия'],
 ['anesthesia','Анестезиология'],['inpatient','Стационар']
]);
const catName=id=>categoryList.find(x=>x[0]===id)?.[1]||'Все направления';
const demoIcon={radiology:'radiology',dietetics:'dietetics',traumatology:'traumatology',pulmonology:'pulmonology',reproduction:'reproduction',endosurgery:'surgery',endocrinology:'endocrinology',intensive:'inpatient',anesthesia:'general_care',inpatient:'inpatient',orthopedics:'orthopedics'};
const categoryImage=id=>vetoraIcon(demoIcon[id]||medicalAssetMap[id]||'general_care','category-image');
const v25ClinicRating=c=>4.85+((Math.max(0,clinics.findIndex(x=>x.id===c.id))*3)%15)/100;
const v25RatingText=c=>v25ClinicRating(c).toFixed(2).replace('.',',');
const v25RatingReviews=c=>(Math.max(35,Number(c.reviews)||0)+(Math.max(0,clinics.indexOf(c))*11));
const displayRating=c=>`<span class="v-demo-rating v25-demo-rating" title="Иллюстративная оценка для прототипа">★ ${v25RatingText(c)} · ${v25RatingReviews(c)} отзывов · демо</span>`;
const clinicIsOpen=c=>{if(/круглосуточно/i.test(c.hours))return true;const t=[...String(c.hours).matchAll(/(\d{2}):(\d{2})/g)];if(t.length<2)return false;const moscow=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB',{timeZone:'Europe/Moscow',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hourCycle:'h23'}).format(new Date());const [h,m]=moscow.split(':').map(Number);const now=h*60+m;return now>=Number(t[0][1])*60+Number(t[0][2])&&now<Number(t[1][1])*60+Number(t[1][2]);};
const formDay=n=>{const date=new Date();date.setHours(12,0,0,0);date.setDate(date.getDate()+n);return date;};
const isoDay=n=>{const d=formDay(n);return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;};
const weekdays=['Вс','Пн','Вт','Ср','Чт','Пт','Сб'];
function demoSlots(c,day=0){const index=clinics.indexOf(c),now=new Date();return [0,1,2,3,4,5,6].map(i=>{const start=10+((index+i+day)%10);const mm=i%2?'30':'00';return String(start).padStart(2,'0')+':'+mm;}).sort().filter(t=>day>0||Number(t.slice(0,2))*60+Number(t.slice(3))>now.getHours()*60+now.getMinutes()+30);}
function bookingNote(){return '';}

const areas=[['all','Москва, все районы'],['center','Центр Москвы'],['nw','Северо-запад Москвы'],['west','Запад Москвы'],['se','Юго-восток Москвы'],['south','Юг Москвы'],['mo','Московская область']];
const state={page:'home',q:'',category:'all',area:'all',network:'all',sort:'default',service:'',clinic:'',region:'all',homeLimit:6,mapClinic:'',demoSession:false};
let favorites=new Set();try{favorites=new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('vetora-v2-favorites')||'[]').filter(id=>clinics.some(c=>c.id===id)));}catch{}
let appointments=[];
try {const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('vetora-appointments-v1')||'[]');if(Array.isArray(saved))appointments=saved.filter(a=>a&&typeof a==='object'&&typeof a.id==='string');}catch{}
function persistAppointments(){try{localStorage.setItem('vetora-appointments-v1',JSON.stringify(appointments));return true;}catch{return false;}}
let trigger=null, toastTimer, focusAfterRoute=null;
const navItems=[['home','Главная'],['clinics','Клиники'],['doctors','Врачи'],['services','Услуги']];
const brand=()=>`<a class="brand" href="#home" aria-label="Vetora — главная">${image(0)}<span>Vetora</span></a>`;

// Vetora v14 — unified local search: clinics, doctors, services and specializations.
// Only data already present in the prototype is indexed; no server requests.
const searchTerms={
 therapy:'терапевт терапия терапевтический прием осмотр врач',
 surgery:'хирургия хирург операция операции', diagnostic:'узи узи диагностика ультразвук ультразвуковой обследование',
 dental:'стоматология стоматолог зубы зубной',dermatology:'дерматология дерматолог кожа шерсть зуд аллергия',
 cardiology:'кардиология кардиолог сердце эхо экг',vaccination:'вакцинация вакцина прививка прививки',
 ophthalmology:'офтальмология офтальмолог глаз зрение',neurology:'неврология невролог мозг нервы',
 oncology:'онкология онколог опухоль',orthopedics:'травматология ортопедия ортопед кости суставы'
};
const searchKinds=[['specialty','Специальности'],['clinic','Клиники'],['doctor','Врачи'],['service','Услуги']];
const searchLabel={specialty:'Направление',clinic:'Клиника',doctor:'Врач',service:'Услуга'};
function searchCatalog(area='all'){
 const available=publicClinics().filter(c=>area==='all'||c.area===area),result=[];
 const allDoctors=state.region==='mo'?[]:doctors;
 for(const [id,title] of categoryList.filter(x=>x[0]!=='all'))result.push({kind:'specialty',id,title,sub:allDoctors.filter(d=>d.categories.includes(id)).length+' специалистов',raw:normalize(title+' '+searchTerms[id]),icon:medicalAssetMap[id]||'general_care'});
 for(const c of available)result.push({kind:'clinic',id:c.id,title:c.name,sub:c.address.replace(/^Москва,\s*/,''),raw:normalize([c.name,c.network,c.address,c.location,...c.services.map(s=>s.title+' '+(searchTerms[s.category]||''))].join(' ')),image:c.image});
 for(const d of allDoctors)result.push({kind:'doctor',id:d.id,title:d.name,sub:d.title,raw:normalize([d.name,d.title,d.description,...d.categories.map(k=>catName(k)+' '+(searchTerms[k]||''))].join(' ')),image:d.image});
 const servicesById=new Map();
 for(const c of available)for(const s of c.services){
  if(!servicesById.has(s.id))servicesById.set(s.id,{kind:'service',id:s.id,title:s.title,sub:catName(s.category),category:s.category,price:s.price,providers:new Set(),raw:normalize(s.title+' '+s.detail+' '+catName(s.category)+' '+(searchTerms[s.category]||'')),icon:serviceIconId(s)});
  const item=servicesById.get(s.id);item.providers.add(c.id);item.price=Math.min(item.price,s.price);
 }
 for(const x of servicesById.values()){x.sub=x.providers.size+' клин. · от '+money(x.price);result.push(x);}
 return result;
}
function searchRank(item,query){
 const q=normalize(query);if(!q)return item.kind==='specialty'?50:item.kind==='clinic'?30:10;
 const title=normalize(item.title),tokens=q.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
 if(tokens.some(t=>!item.raw.includes(t)))return 0;
 if(title===q)return 130;
 if(title.startsWith(q))return 115;
 if(title.split(/[^а-яa-z0-9]+/i).some(w=>w.startsWith(q)))return 100;
 if(title.includes(q))return 90;
 return 40;
}
function findSearch(query='',area='all'){
 return searchCatalog(area).map(item=>({...item,rank:searchRank(item,query)})).filter(x=>x.rank>0).sort((a,b)=>b.rank-a.rank||a.title.localeCompare(b.title,'ru'));
}
function searchGroups(query,area){const found=findSearch(query,area),groups={};for(const [k] of searchKinds)groups[k]=found.filter(x=>x.kind===k);return groups;}
const searchIcon=item=>item.kind==='clinic'?vetoraIcon('clinic','search-item-icon'):item.kind==='doctor'?`<img class="search-item-photo" src="${esc(asset(item.image))}" alt="">`:vetoraIcon(item.icon||'general_care','search-item-icon');
function markQuery(text,query){
 const str=String(text||'');const q=normalize(query);if(!q)return esc(str);
 const i=normalize(str).indexOf(q);if(i<0)return esc(str);
 return esc(str.slice(0,i))+'<mark>'+esc(str.slice(i,i+q.length))+'</mark>'+esc(str.slice(i+q.length));
}
let activeSearchOption=-1;
let searchOpen=false,areaOpen=false;
function smartSearchForm(){return `<form class="search smart-search" id="hero-search" role="search" autocomplete="off">
 <div class="smart-search-field"><label class="field-shell" for="hero-query">${svg('search')}<input type="search" name="q" id="hero-query" role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="hero-suggestions" aria-label="Клиника, услуга или врач" placeholder="Клиника, услуга или врач" autocomplete="off" value="${esc(state.q)}"><button class="search-clear" type="button" data-action="search-clear" aria-label="Очистить поиск" ${state.q?'':'hidden'}>${svg('close')}</button></label>
 <div class="search-suggestions" id="hero-suggestions" role="listbox" aria-label="Поисковые подсказки" hidden></div></div>
 <div class="smart-area-field"><input type="hidden" id="hero-area" name="area" value="${esc(state.area)}"><button type="button" id="hero-area-button" class="smart-area-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-controls="hero-area-list" aria-label="Выбрать район или территорию"><span class="smart-area-title">${esc(areas.find(a=>a[0]===state.area)?.[1]||areas[0][1])}</span>${svg('down')}</button>
 <div class="search-area-list" id="hero-area-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Территории поиска" hidden>${areas.map(([id,name])=>`<button type="button" role="option" data-area-select="${esc(id)}" aria-selected="${state.area===id}"><span>${esc(name)}</span>${state.area===id?svg('check'):''}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>
 <button class="btn primary" type="submit">Найти</button></form>`;}
function closeSearchPanels(){searchOpen=false;areaOpen=false;activeSearchOption=-1;const suggest=$('#hero-suggestions'),list=$('#hero-area-list'),input=$('#hero-query'),area=$('#hero-area-button');if(suggest)suggest.hidden=true;if(list)list.hidden=true;if(input){input.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');}if(area)area.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');}
function showSearchSuggestions(){
 const box=$('#hero-suggestions'),input=$('#hero-query');if(!box||!input)return;
 const query=input.value.trim(),area=$('#hero-area')?.value||'all',groups=searchGroups(query,area);
 const parts=[];let count=0;
 for(const [kind,title] of searchKinds){const items=groups[kind];if(!items.length)continue;
  const subset=items.slice(0,kind==='clinic'?4:kind==='specialty'?3:kind==='doctor'?4:4);
  parts.push(`<div class="suggest-heading" role="presentation"><span>${title}</span><span>${items.length}</span></div>`);
  for(const item of subset){parts.push(`<button id="suggest-${count}" type="button" class="suggest-option" role="option" aria-selected="false" data-suggest-kind="${kind}" data-suggest-id="${esc(item.id)}" data-suggest-category="${esc(item.category||'')}">${searchIcon(item)}<span class="suggest-main"><strong>${markQuery(item.title,query)}</strong><small>${esc(item.sub)}</small></span>${svg('arrow')}</button>`);count++;}
 }
 if(!count)parts.push(`<div class="search-no-hits">Совпадений не найдено. Проверьте запрос или выберите другую территорию.</div>`);
 else parts.push(`<button type="button" class="suggest-all" data-suggest-kind="all">${svg('search')}<span>Показать все результаты${query?' по запросу «'+esc(query)+'»':''}</span>${svg('arrow')}</button>`);
 box.innerHTML=parts.join('');box.hidden=false;searchOpen=true;activeSearchOption=-1;input.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
 const clear=$('.search-clear');if(clear)clear.hidden=!input.value;
}
function searchOptionList(){return $$('#hero-suggestions [data-suggest-kind]');}
function activateSearchOption(index){const input=$('#hero-query'),list=searchOptionList();if(!input||!list.length)return;activeSearchOption=(index+list.length)%list.length;for(const [i,el] of list.entries()){const active=i===activeSearchOption;el.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(active));el.classList.toggle('is-active',active);}input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant',list[activeSearchOption].id||'');list[activeSearchOption].scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});}
function selectSuggestion(el){
 if(!el)return;const kind=el.dataset.suggestKind,id=el.dataset.suggestId,cat=el.dataset.suggestCategory,query=$('#hero-query')?.value.trim()||'';
 closeSearchPanels();
 if(kind==='all')route('search',{q:query,area:$('#hero-area')?.value||'all',category:'all',network:'all',service:''});
 else if(kind==='clinic')route('clinic',{clinic:id,q:'',service:'',category:'all'});
 else if(kind==='doctor'){route('doctors',{q:doctors.find(d=>d.id===id)?.name||query,area:'all',category:'all',service:''});}
 else if(kind==='service')route('clinics',{q:'',service:id,category:cat||'all',network:'all',area:$('#hero-area')?.value||'all'});
 else if(kind==='specialty')route('doctors',{q:'',category:id,service:'',area:'all'});
}
function toggleAreaList(force){const panel=$('#hero-area-list'),btn=$('#hero-area-button');if(!panel)return;const next=typeof force==='boolean'?force:panel.hidden;if(next){const suggest=$('#hero-suggestions');if(suggest){suggest.hidden=true;searchOpen=false;$('#hero-query')?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');}panel.hidden=false;btn?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');areaOpen=true;}else{panel.hidden=true;btn?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');areaOpen=false;}}
function setSearchArea(area){const hidden=$('#hero-area'),button=$('#hero-area-button');if(!hidden||!button)return;hidden.value=area;button.querySelector('.smart-area-title').textContent=areas.find(a=>a[0]===area)?.[1]||areas[0][1];toggleAreaList(false);if(searchOpen)showSearchSuggestions();}
function searchClinicCard(c,query){
 const needle=normalize(query),matched=needle&&!normalize(c.name+' '+c.address).includes(needle)
  ?c.services.find(s=>searchRank({title:s.title,raw:normalize(s.title+' '+catName(s.category)+' '+(searchTerms[s.category]||''))},needle)>0):null;
 const card=clinicCard(c);
 return matched?card.replace(/<div class="clinic-price">[\s\S]*?<\/div>/,`<div class="clinic-price">${esc(matched.title)} <strong>${money(matched.price)}</strong></div>`):card;
}
function searchResultService(item){return `<button class="service" data-action="service" data-service="${esc(item.id)}" data-category="${esc(item.category)}"><span class="service-main">${vetoraIcon(item.icon,'service-icon')}<span class="service-copy"><strong>${esc(item.title)}</strong><small>${esc(item.sub)}</small></span></span><span class="price-pill">от ${money(item.price)}</span></button>`;}
function searchResultsPage(){const q=state.q.trim(),groups=searchGroups(q,state.area),total=Object.values(groups).reduce((n,a)=>n+a.length,0);
 const intro=q?`Результаты по запросу «${esc(q)}»`:'Найдите врача, клинику или услугу';
 const sections=[];
 for(const [kind,title] of [['clinic','Клиники'],['doctor','Врачи'],['service','Услуги'],['specialty','Направления помощи']]){
  const items=groups[kind];if(!items.length)continue;
  const content=kind==='clinic'?`<div class="clinic-grid">${items.slice(0,6).map(it=>searchClinicCard(clinics.find(c=>c.id===it.id),q)).join('')}</div>`:
  kind==='doctor'?`<div class="doctor-grid">${items.slice(0,6).map(it=>doctorCard(doctors.find(d=>d.id===it.id))).join('')}</div>`:
  kind==='service'?`<div class="service-grid">${items.slice(0,9).map(searchResultService).join('')}</div>`:
  `<div class="search-specialty-grid">${items.slice(0,10).map(it=>`<button class="search-specialty" data-action="specialists" data-category="${esc(it.id)}">${vetoraIcon(it.icon,'category-image')}<span>${esc(it.title)}</span>${svg('arrow')}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
  const extra=items.length>(kind==='service'?9:kind==='specialty'?10:6)?`<button class="btn search-show-all" data-action="search-category" data-kind="${kind}">Показать все (${items.length}) ${svg('arrow')}</button>`:'';
  sections.push(`<section class="section search-result-group"><div class="section-head"><h2>${title} <span class="search-count">${items.length}</span></h2></div>${content}${extra}</section>`);
 }
 return `${breadcrumb('Поиск')}<div class="page-title search-page-header"><div><h1>${intro}</h1><p>Ищите по названию, специализации, адресу или услуге. Подсказки обновляются по мере ввода.</p></div></div><section class="search-page-toolbar">${smartSearchForm()}${state.area!=='all'?'<p class="search-area-note">Территория ограничивает результаты по клиникам и услугам. Профили врачей ищутся по специальности и ФИО.</p>':''}</section><div class="search-total" role="status" aria-live="polite">${q?(total?'Найдено совпадений: '+total:'По запросу ничего не найдено'):'Выберите подходящий раздел или начните вводить запрос'}</div>${sections.length?sections.join(''):empty('Ничего не найдено','Попробуйте другое название, более короткий запрос или выберите все районы.',false)}`;
}

function route(page,changes={}){const next={...state,...changes,page};const p=new URLSearchParams();for(const k of ['q','category','area','network','sort','service','clinic','region'])if(next[k]&&next[k]!==({category:'all',area:'all',network:'all',sort:'default',region:'all'}[k]||''))p.set(k,next[k]);const hash=page+(p.size?'?'+p:'');if(location.hash.slice(1)===hash){readRoute();}else location.hash=hash;}
function readRoute(){const [page,params='']=location.hash.slice(1).split('?');const p=new URLSearchParams(params);state.page=['home','search','clinics','doctors','services','clinic','favorites','map','about'].includes(page)?page:'home';for(const k of ['q','category','area','network','sort','service','clinic','region'])state[k]=p.get(k)||({category:'all',area:'all',network:'all',sort:'default',region:'all'}[k]||'');if(!['all','moscow','mo'].includes(state.region))state.region='all';if(!['all',...new Set(clinics.map(c=>c.network))].includes(state.network))state.network='all';if(!['default','low','name'].includes(state.sort))state.sort='default';if(!categoryList.some(c=>c[0]===state.category))state.category='all';if(!areas.some(a=>a[0]===state.area))state.area='all';render();window.scrollTo(0,0);const focusTarget=focusAfterRoute&&$('#'+focusAfterRoute);(focusTarget||$('#main')).focus({preventScroll:true});focusAfterRoute=null;}
function renderHeader(){const active=state.page==='clinic'?'clinics':state.page;$('#header').innerHTML=`${brand()}<nav class="nav" aria-label="Основная навигация">${navItems.map(([id,label])=>`<a href="#${id}${state.region!=='all'?'?region='+encodeURIComponent(state.region):''}" ${active===id?'aria-current="page"':''}>${label}</a>`).join('')}</nav><div class="header-actions"><button class="location-button" data-action="region" aria-label="Выбрать регион: ${regionName()}">${svg('pin')}<span>${regionName()}</span>${svg('down')}</button><button class="btn white" data-action="${state.demoSession?'account':'login'}">${vetoraIcon('profile','account-icon')}${state.demoSession?'Кабинет':'Войти'}</button></div>`;document.querySelector('.mobile-nav')?.remove();document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<nav class="mobile-nav" aria-label="Навигация на мобильном">${navItems.map(([id,label])=>`<a href="#${id}${state.region!=='all'?'?region='+encodeURIComponent(state.region):''}" ${active===id?'aria-current="page"':''}>${vetoraIcon(mobileNavIcon[id],'nav-image')}${label}</a>`).join('')}</nav>`);}
const regionName=()=>state.region==='moscow'?'Москва':state.region==='mo'?'Московская область':'Москва и область';
const opts=(items,value)=>items.map(([v,t])=>`<option value="${esc(v)}" ${v===value?'selected':''}>${esc(t)}</option>`).join('');
function renderFooter(){$('#footer').innerHTML=`<div class="footer-grid"><div>${brand()}<p>Ветеринарная помощь рядом.<br>Выбирайте с заботой о питомце.</p></div><div><strong>Найти помощь</strong><a href="#clinics">Клиники</a><a href="#doctors">Специалисты</a><a href="#services">Услуги и цены</a></div><div><strong>Для владельца</strong><a href="#favorites">Избранные клиники</a><a href="#about">Как записаться</a><a href="#about?section=sources">О сервисе и данных</a></div><div><strong>Без лишних шагов</strong><p>Сравните клиники и услуги без регистрации. Время приёма подтвердит выбранная клиника.</p><a href="#login" data-action="register">Создать аккаунт ${svg('arrow')}</a></div></div><div class="footer-bottom"><span>© 2026 Vetora</span><span>Цены и доступность услуг уточняйте в клинике</span></div>`;}
function sectionHead(title,link,label,description=''){const id=sectionIconMap[title];return `<div class="section-head"><div class="section-heading">${id?vetoraIcon(id,'section-icon'):''}<div><h2>${title}</h2>${description?`<p>${description}</p>`:''}</div></div>${link?`<a class="text-link" href="${link}">${label}${svg('arrow')}</a>`:''}</div>`;}
function clinicPrice(c){return c.services.find(s=>s.id===state.service)||c.services.find(s=>state.category!=='all'&&s.category===state.category)||c.services.find(s=>s.id==='therapy')||c.services[0];}
function clinicCard(c){const p=clinicPrice(c);return `<article class="clinic-card"><img class="clinic-photo" src="${esc(asset(c.image))}" alt="${esc(c.imgCredit.replace('Фото: ',''))}" loading="lazy"><div class="clinic-body"><div class="clinic-network">${vetoraIcon('clinic','clinic-meta-icon')}${esc(c.network)} · ${esc(c.city)}</div><h3><a href="${clinicHref(c)}">${esc(c.name)}</a></h3><div class="clinic-meta">${svg('pin')}<span>${esc(c.address.replace('Москва, ',''))}</span></div><div class="clinic-meta">${svg('clock')}<span>${esc(c.hours)}</span></div><div class="clinic-price">${state.service||state.category!=='all'?esc(p.title):'Первичный приём'} <strong>${money(p.price)}</strong></div><div class="clinic-actions"><a class="btn" href="${clinicHref(c)}">Подробнее ${svg('arrow')}</a><button class="favorite" data-action="favorite" data-id="${c.id}" aria-label="${favorites.has(c.id)?'Убрать из избранного':'Добавить в избранное'}: ${esc(c.name)}" aria-pressed="${favorites.has(c.id)}">${svg('heart')}</button></div></div></article>`;}
function clinicHref(c){const p=new URLSearchParams({clinic:c.id});for(const k of ['service','category','region'])if(state[k]&&state[k]!=='all')p.set(k,state[k]);return '#clinic?'+p;}
function publicClinics(){return clinics.filter(c=>state.region==='all'||(state.region==='mo'?c.area==='mo':c.area!=='mo'));}
function matchingClinics(){const q=normalize(state.q);return publicClinics().filter(c=>(state.area==='all'||c.area===state.area)&&(state.network==='all'||c.network===state.network)&&(state.category==='all'||c.services.some(s=>s.category===state.category))&&(!state.service||c.services.some(s=>s.id===state.service))&&(!q||normalize([c.name,c.address,c.location,...c.services.map(s=>s.title),...doctors.filter(d=>d.clinicId===c.id&&!d.isDemo).map(d=>d.name)].join(' ')).includes(q))).sort((a,b)=>state.sort==='low'?clinicPrice(a).price-clinicPrice(b).price:state.sort==='name'?a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'ru'):0);}
function specialtyCards(){return categoryList.slice(0,6).map(([id,name])=>`<button class="specialty" data-action="specialists" data-category="${id}"><h3>${id==='therapy'?'Терапевт':id==='surgery'?'Хирург':id==='diagnostic'?'Врач УЗИ':id==='dental'?'Стоматолог':id==='dermatology'?'Дерматолог':'Кардиолог'}</h3><small>Выбрать специалиста</small>${medicalIcon(id,'category-image')}${svg('arrow','mini-arrow')}</button>`).join('');}
function featuredServices(){const selections=[['sd-kuzminki','therapy'],['sd-kuzminki','diagnostic-abdomen'],['sd-kuzminki','microchip'],['sd-kuzminki','vaccine-cat'],['sd-kuzminki','checkup-standard'],['bk-mitino','dental-consult']];return selections.map(([id,sid])=>{const original=clinics.find(c=>c.id===id);const c=publicClinics().find(c=>c.id===id)||publicClinics().find(c=>c.network===original.network&&c.services.some(s=>s.id===sid));if(!c)return '';const s=c.services.find(s=>s.id===sid);return `<button class="service" data-action="service" data-service="${s.id}" data-category="${s.category}"><span class="service-main">${vetoraIcon(serviceIconId(s),'service-icon')}<span class="service-copy"><strong>${esc(s.id==='diagnostic-abdomen'?'УЗИ брюшной полости':s.id==='vaccine-cat'?'Поливалентная вакцинация':s.title)}</strong><small>${esc(c.network)} · ${catName(s.category)}</small></span></span><span class="price-pill">от ${money(s.price)}</span></button>`;}).join('');}
function mapMarkup(large=false){const c=clinics.find(c=>c.id===state.mapClinic);const text=c?c.network+' '+c.address:'ветеринарные клиники '+regionName();const url='https://yandex.ru/map-widget/v1/?text='+encodeURIComponent(text)+'&z='+(c?'15':'11');return `<div class="map-wrap"><iframe title="Карта: ${esc(c?c.name:'ветеринарные клиники Москвы и области')}" src="${esc(url)}" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" allowfullscreen></iframe><div class="map-caption"><strong>${c?esc(c.name):'Клиники на карте'}</strong><small>Яндекс Карты · Для загрузки нужен интернет</small></div></div>`;}
function mapOptions(){return `<label><span class="sr-only">Клиника на карте</span><select id="map-select">${opts([['','Все клиники'],...publicClinics().map(c=>[c.id,c.name])],state.mapClinic)}</select></label>`;}
function pharmacyCards(){return [['Открытое шоссе, 5, корп. 6','Бульвар Рокоссовского'],['Нижняя Красносельская, 28','Красносельская'],['Егерская улица, 1','Сокольники']].map(([address,metro])=>`<a class="pharmacy" href="https://www.vetlek.ru/contacts/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${vetoraIcon('clinic','pharmacy-icon')}<span><strong>Ветлек · ${metro}</strong><small>${address}</small></span>${svg('external','external')}</a>`).join('');}
function home(){const list=matchingClinics();return `<section class="hero" aria-labelledby="hero-title"><div class="hero-copy"><div class="eyebrow">Забота начинается с правильного выбора</div><h1 id="hero-title">Поиск по врачам и клиникам ${state.region==='mo'?'в Подмосковье':'в Москве'}</h1><p>Найдите клинику, врача или нужную услугу.<br>Сравните предложения и перейдите к записи без регистрации.</p></div>${image(3,'hero-art')}${smartSearchForm()}</section>
<div class="quick-grid" aria-label="Быстрые действия"><a class="quick" href="#clinics"><span class="quick-icon">${vetoraIcon('quick_booking')}</span><span><strong>Найти запись</strong><small>Выбрать услугу и клинику</small></span></a><button class="quick" data-action="${state.demoSession?'account':'login'}"><span class="quick-icon">${vetoraIcon('clinic')}</span><span><strong>Мои клиники</strong><small>${state.demoSession?'Личный кабинет':'После входа в аккаунт'}</small></span></button><button class="quick" data-action="${state.demoSession?'account':'login'}"><span class="quick-icon">${vetoraIcon('pet_passport')}</span><span><strong>Карта питомца</strong><small>После входа в аккаунт</small></span></button><a class="quick" href="#favorites"><span class="quick-icon"><img src="${asset('assets/vetora-3d-heart.png')}" alt="" aria-hidden="true"></span><span><strong>Избранное</strong><small>Сохраняйте без входа</small></span></a></div>
<section class="section">${sectionHead('Популярные специалисты','#doctors','Все врачи')}<div class="specialty-grid">${specialtyCards()}</div></section>
<section class="section">${sectionHead('Популярные услуги','#services','Все услуги')}<div class="service-grid">${featuredServices()}</div><p class="source-note">Цены из официальных прайсов. Итоговая стоимость и состав услуги — в выбранной клинике.</p></section>
<section class="section"><div class="section-head clinic-section-head"><div class="section-heading">${vetoraIcon('clinic','section-icon')}<h2>Клиники Москвы и области</h2></div><div class="section-controls"><label><span class="sr-only">Направление в подборке клиник</span><select id="home-category">${opts([['all','Все направления'],...categoryList.filter(c=>['therapy','surgery','diagnostic','dental','vaccination'].includes(c[0]))],state.category)}</select></label><a class="btn" href="#clinics">Все клиники ${svg('arrow')}</a></div></div><div class="clinic-grid" id="home-clinics">${list.length?list.slice(0,state.homeLimit).map(clinicCard).join(''):empty('Нет клиник по выбранным условиям','Попробуйте другое направление или измените регион.')}</div>${list.length>state.homeLimit?`<div class="center"><button class="btn" data-action="more">Показать ещё ${list.length-state.homeLimit}</button></div>`:''}</section>
<section class="section"><div class="section-head"><div class="section-heading">${vetoraIcon('map','section-icon')}<h2>На карте</h2></div><div class="section-controls">${mapOptions()}<a class="btn" href="#map">Большая карта ${svg('external')}</a></div></div><div id="map-content">${mapMarkup()}</div></section>
<section class="section">${sectionHead('Направления','','')}<div class="directions">${categoryList.map(([id,name])=>`<button class="direction" data-action="direction" data-category="${id}">${medicalIcon(id,'category-image')}<span>${name}</span></button>`).join('')}</div></section>
<section class="section">${sectionHead('Ветаптеки','https://www.vetlek.ru/contacts/','Адреса и часы работы')}<div class="pharmacy-grid">${pharmacyCards()}</div></section>`;}
function breadcrumb(text){return `<nav class="breadcrumb" aria-label="Навигационная цепочка"><a href="#home">Главная</a><span aria-hidden="true">/</span><span aria-current="page">${esc(text)}</span></nav>`;}
function empty(title,body,button=true){return `<div class="empty">${vetoraIcon('action_filter','empty-icon')}<h2>${esc(title)}</h2><p>${esc(body)}</p>${button?'<button class="btn" data-action="reset">Сбросить фильтры</button>':''}</div>`;}
function filters(kind='clinics'){return `<div class="filter-bar"><label class="sr-only" for="catalog-query">Поиск по ${kind==='doctors'?'специалистам':'клиникам'}</label><input id="catalog-query" type="search" placeholder="${kind==='doctors'?'Фамилия или специализация':'Название, адрес, врач или услуга'}" value="${esc(state.q)}" autocomplete="off"><label><span class="sr-only">Район или город</span><select id="filter-area">${opts(areas,state.area)}</select></label><label><span class="sr-only">Сеть клиник</span><select id="filter-network">${opts([['all','Все сети'],['Белый Клык','Белый Клык'],['Свой Доктор','Свой Доктор']],state.network)}</select></label><label><span class="sr-only">Сортировать</span><select id="filter-sort">${opts([['default','По умолчанию'],['low','Сначала дешевле'],['name','По названию']],state.sort)}</select></label></div>`;}
function chips(){return `<div class="chip-row" role="group" aria-label="Направление">${[['all','Все направления'],...categoryList.filter(c=>c[0]!=='all')].map(([id,name])=>`<button class="chip" data-action="category" data-category="${id}" aria-pressed="${state.category===id}">${name}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;}

function vSearchRow(forPage='clinics'){
 const clinic=forPage==='clinics',id=clinic?'catalog-query':forPage==='doctors'?'doctor-query':'service-query';
 return `<form id="directory-search" class="v-search-row" role="search">
 <label class="field-shell v-directory-search-field">${svg('search')}<span class="sr-only">Поиск по клинике, услуге или врачу</span><input id="${id}" type="search" placeholder="Найти клинику, услугу или врача" autocomplete="off" value="${esc(state.q)}"></label>
 ${clinic?`<label class="v-select-label"><span class="sr-only">Район Москвы</span><select id="filter-area">${opts(areas,state.area)}</select></label>`:
 `<label class="v-select-label"><span class="sr-only">Клиника</span><select id="v-doctor-clinic"><option value="all">Все клиники</option>${clinics.map(c=>`<option value="${esc(c.id)}" ${doctorUI.clinic===c.id?'selected':''}>${esc(c.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>`}
 <button class="btn primary" type="submit">Найти</button></form>`;
}
function vPager(page,total,action='v-page'){
 if(total<=1)return '';
 return `<nav class="v-pager" aria-label="Страницы результатов"><button data-action="${action}" data-page="${Math.max(1,page-1)}" ${page<=1?'disabled':''}>‹</button>${Array.from({length:total},(_,i)=>`<button class="${page===i+1?'active':''}" data-action="${action}" data-page="${i+1}" aria-current="${page===i+1?'page':'false'}">${i+1}</button>`).join('')}<button data-action="${action}" data-page="${Math.min(total,page+1)}" ${page>=total?'disabled':''}>›</button></nav>`;
}
function vClinicList(){
 let list=matchingClinics();
 if(dirUI.openNow)list=list.filter(clinicIsOpen);
 if(dirUI.onlyDemo)list=list.filter(c=>clinicPrice(c).price<=2000);
 if(dirUI.clinicType==='network')list=list.filter(c=>['Белый Клык','Свой Доктор'].some(n=>normalize(c.network).includes(normalize(n))));
 if(dirUI.clinicType==='independent')list=list.filter(c=>!['Белый Клык','Свой Доктор'].some(n=>normalize(c.network).includes(normalize(n))));
 if(dirUI.metro!=='all')list=list.filter(c=>c.location===dirUI.metro);
 if(dirUI.daySlots)list=list.filter(c=>demoSlots(c,dirUI.day).length);
 if(dirUI.category!=='all')list=list.filter(c=>c.services.some(s=>s.category===dirUI.category));
 if(dirUI.sort==='price')list.sort((a,b)=>clinicPrice(a).price-clinicPrice(b).price);
 if(dirUI.sort==='name')list.sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'ru'));
 return list;
}
function vFilterPanel(){
 return `<aside class="v-filter-panel" aria-label="Фильтры клиник">
 <div class="v-panel-title"><h2>Подобрать клинику</h2><span>Уточните параметры</span></div>
 <label>Тип клиники<select id="v-filter-type">${opts([['all','Любая клиника'],['network','Сетевая'],['independent','Независимая']],dirUI.clinicType)}</select></label>
 <label>Метро / район<select id="v-filter-metro">${opts([['all','Любое метро'],...[...new Set(clinics.map(c=>c.location))].map(v=>[v,v])],dirUI.metro)}</select></label>
 <label>Направление врача<select id="v-filter-category">${opts([['all','Все специализации'],...categoryList.filter(x=>x[0]!=='all')],dirUI.category)}</select></label>
 <label>Сеть клиник<select id="filter-network">${opts([['all','Все сети'],...new Set(clinics.map(c=>c.network))].map(v=>Array.isArray(v)?v:[v,v]),state.network)}</select></label>
 <label>Сортировка<select id="v-dir-sort">${opts([['default','По релевантности'],['price','Сначала дешевле'],['name','По названию']],dirUI.sort)}</select></label>
 <div class="v-filter-line"></div>
 <div class="v-filter-toggles">
 <label><input type="checkbox" id="v-open-now" ${dirUI.openNow?'checked':''}><span>Работает сейчас</span></label>
 <label><input type="checkbox" id="v-day-slots" ${dirUI.daySlots?'checked':''}><span>Есть свободное время</span></label>
 <label><input type="checkbox" id="v-only-demo" ${dirUI.onlyDemo?'checked':''}><span>Первичный приём до 2 000 ₽</span></label>
 </div><div class="v-filter-buttons"><button class="btn" data-action="v-filter-clear">Сбросить</button><button class="btn primary" data-action="v-filter-apply">Подобрать</button></div>
 </aside>`;
}
function vSlotPicker(c,compact=false){
 const requested=detailUI.serviceByClinic[c.id]||state.service;
 const active=c.services.find(s=>s.id===requested)||c.services[0];
 const cat=active?.category||'therapy';
 const base=compact?dirUI.day:detailUI.selectedDay;
 const weekStart=compact?dirUI.weekStart:detailUI.weekStart;
 const offsets=Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>weekStart+i);
 const visible=offsets.includes(base)?base:weekStart;
 return `<div class="v-slot-picker ${compact?'compact':''}">
 <div class="vx-book-selects"><label><span class="sr-only">Направление</span><select data-v-slot-category="${esc(c.id)}">${opts([...new Map(c.services.map(s=>[s.category,[s.category,catName(s.category)]])).values()],cat)}</select></label>
 <label><span class="sr-only">Услуга и стоимость</span><select data-v-slot-service="${esc(c.id)}">${c.services.filter(s=>s.category===cat).map(s=>`<option value="${esc(s.id)}" ${s.id===active?.id?'selected':''}>${esc(s.title)} · ${money(s.price)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label></div>
 <div class="v-slot-heading v18-calendar-heading"><strong>Дата приёма</strong><div class="v18-calendar-nav" role="group" aria-label="Перелистывание недель"><button type="button" class="v-calendar-arrow prev" data-action="v-week-prev" data-compact="${compact?'1':'0'}" aria-label="Предыдущая неделя" title="Предыдущая неделя" ${weekStart===0?'disabled':''}>${svg('arrow')}</button><span class="v-calendar-month" aria-live="polite">${formDay(visible).toLocaleDateString('ru-RU',{month:'long',year:'numeric'})}</span><button type="button" class="v-calendar-arrow next" data-action="v-week-next" data-compact="${compact?'1':'0'}" aria-label="Следующая неделя" title="Следующая неделя" ${weekStart>=360?'disabled':''}>${svg('arrow')}</button></div></div>
 <div class="v-dates">${offsets.map(n=>{const d=formDay(n);return `<button class="${n===visible?'active':''}" data-action="v-clinic-date" data-id="${esc(c.id)}" data-offset="${n}" data-compact="${compact?'1':'0'}" type="button"><small>${weekdays[d.getDay()]}</small>${d.getDate()}</button>`;}).join('')}</div>
 <div class="v-times">${demoSlots(c,visible).map(t=>`<button data-action="v-clinic-slot" data-id="${esc(c.id)}" data-date="${isoDay(visible)}" data-time="${t}" type="button">${t}</button>`).join('')}</div>
 </div>`;
}
function vClinicBookingPanel(c){
 const requested=detailUI.serviceByClinic[c.id]||state.service;
 const selected=c.services.find(s=>s.id===requested)||c.services[0];
 if(selected)detailUI.serviceByClinic[c.id]=selected.id;
 const category=selected?.category||'therapy';
 const availableServices=c.services.filter(s=>s.category===category);
 const categories=[...new Map(c.services.map(s=>[s.category,[s.category,catName(s.category)]])).values()];
 return `<section id="vx-clinic-booking" class="vx-block vx-booking-section" aria-label="Выбор ветеринарной услуги и времени">
 <div class="vx-section-heading"><h2>Свободные даты</h2></div>
 <div class="vx-booking-grid"><div class="vx-booking-fields">
 <label>Специалист<select id="vx-booking-category" aria-label="Специализация врача">${opts(categories,category)}</select></label>
 <label>Услуга<select data-v-slot-service="${esc(c.id)}" aria-label="Услуга и стоимость">${availableServices.map(s=>`<option value="${esc(s.id)}" ${s.id===selected?.id?'selected':''}>${esc(s.title)} · ${money(s.price)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
 </div><div class="vx-booking-calendar">${vSlotPicker(c,false)}</div></div></section>`;
}
function vRefreshClinicBooking(){
 const old=document.getElementById('vx-clinic-booking');
 if(!old)return;
 const c=clinics.find(c=>c.id===state.clinic)||clinics.find(c=>c.id==='vd-tailhelp');
 if(!c)return;
 const box=document.createElement('template');
 box.innerHTML=vClinicBookingPanel(c);
 const next=box.content.firstElementChild;
 if(next)old.replaceWith(next);
}
function vCatalogCard(c){
 const p=clinicPrice(c),team=doctors.filter(d=>d.clinicId===c.id);
 return `<article class="v-clinic-result vx-wide-clinic" data-clinic-card="${esc(c.id)}">
 <div class="v-clinic-image-col"><a href="${clinicHref(c)}"><img src="${esc(asset(c.image))}" alt="${c.isDemo?'Иллюстративное фото для макета':'Фотография фасада клиники'}" loading="lazy"></a>${displayRating(c)}<div class="vx-match"><strong>${Math.max(75,92-(clinics.indexOf(c)%4)*6)}</strong> соответствие </div></div>
 <div class="v-clinic-info"><h2><a href="${clinicHref(c)}">${esc(c.name)}</a></h2>
 <div class="v-card-tools"><button data-action="favorite" data-id="${esc(c.id)}" aria-pressed="${favorites.has(c.id)}">${svg('heart')} В избранное</button><button data-action="v-compare" data-id="${esc(c.id)}" aria-pressed="${dirUI.compare.has(c.id)}">${svg('arrow')} Сравнить</button></div>
 <div class="v-clinic-muted">Клиника · <button data-action="v-open-clinic-doctors" data-id="${esc(c.id)}">${team.length} врачей</button> · <button data-action="v-open-clinic-services" data-id="${esc(c.id)}">${c.services.length} услуг</button></div>
 <p class="v-info-line">${svg('pin')} <a href="https://yandex.ru/maps/?text=${encodeURIComponent(c.address)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${esc(c.address)}</a></p>
 <p class="vx-metro">● ${esc(c.location||'Метро уточняется')}</p>
 <p class="v-info-line">${svg('clock')} <span>${esc(c.hours)}</span></p>
 ${c.url?`<p class="v-info-line">${svg('external')} <a href="${esc(c.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Сайт клиники</a></p>`:''}
 ${c.phone?`<p class="v-info-line">${vetoraIcon('phone','v-small-img')}<a href="tel:${c.phone.replace(/[^+\d]/g,'')}">${esc(c.phone)}</a></p>`:''}
 <p class="v-info-line">${svg('clock')} <span>Первичный приём — от ${money(p.price)}</span></p>
 </div>${vSlotPicker(c,true)}</article>`;
}
// Yandex Maps widget: native interactive map. Without an API key it is an embedded map,
// not a custom JS map. The focused clinic and filtered set are managed in the prototype.
// Positions of illustrative clinics indicate a neighbourhood, not a verified building.
const v25MetroCoordinates={
 'савеловская':[55.794,37.588],'аэропорт':[55.801,37.532],'академическая':[55.688,37.572],
 'сокол':[55.805,37.516],'пресня':[55.763,37.573],'крылатское':[55.756,37.408],
 'митино':[55.845,37.359],'чертаново':[55.640,37.606],'бирюлево':[55.588,37.664],
 'красногорск':[55.831,37.327],'мытищи':[55.911,37.748],'химки':[55.888,37.429],
 'кузьминки':[55.707,37.766],'арбат':[55.752,37.593],'университет':[55.693,37.534],
 'отрадное':[55.861,37.607],'бибирево':[55.884,37.603],'тверская':[55.765,37.607],
 'таганская':[55.740,37.650],'полежаевская':[55.778,37.518],'шаболовская':[55.719,37.608],
 'перово':[55.751,37.786],'щелковская':[55.810,37.798],'алтуфьево':[55.898,37.588],
 'ясенево':[55.606,37.536],'солнцево':[55.649,37.392],'юго-западная':[55.664,37.483]
};
function v18Coordinate(c){
 const line=normalize((c.location||'')+' '+(c.address||''));
 const match=Object.entries(v25MetroCoordinates).find(([k])=>line.includes(k));
 if(match)return match[1];
 const i=clinics.indexOf(c),angle=(i*137.508)*Math.PI/180;
 return [55.751+Math.cos(angle)*(.04+(i%4)*.014),37.618+Math.sin(angle)*(.065+(i%5)*.025)];
}
function v25YandexParams(list,focus){
 const coord=focus?v18Coordinate(focus):[55.751,37.618];
 const lon=coord[1].toFixed(6),lat=coord[0].toFixed(6);
 const ll=`${lon},${lat}`;
 const pt=list.slice(0,30).map(c=>{const [a,b]=v18Coordinate(c);return `${b.toFixed(6)},${a.toFixed(6)},pm2blm`}).join('~');
 const params=new URLSearchParams({ll,z:focus?'13':'10',lang:'ru_RU'});
 if(pt)params.set('pt',pt);
 return {url:'https://yandex.ru/map-widget/v1/?'+params.toString(),
  full:'https://yandex.ru/maps/?'+params.toString(),coord};
}
function vStaticMap(){
 const list=vClinicList();
 const focus=list.find(c=>c.id===dirUI.focusMapClinic)||null;
 const params=v25YandexParams(list,focus);
 const options=[['','Все найденные клиники'],...list.map(c=>[c.id,c.name+' — '+(c.location||'Москва')])];
 return `<div class="v-map-preview v25-yandex-map-preview">
  <iframe class="v25-yandex-iframe" title="Яндекс Карты — клиники Москвы" src="${esc(params.url)}" loading="eager" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>
  <div class="v25-yandex-select"><label for="v25-map-clinic-filter">Клиники на карте</label><select id="v25-map-clinic-filter" aria-label="Показать клинику на Яндекс Картах">${opts(options,focus?.id||'')}</select></div>
  <div class="v-map-link"><a href="${esc(focus?'https://yandex.ru/maps/?text='+encodeURIComponent(focus.address):params.full)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${vetoraIcon('map','v-small-img')} Открыть в Яндекс Картах ${svg('arrow')}</a></div>
 </div>`;
}
function v18DestroyMap(){} // iframe lifecycle is owned by the DOM
function v18MountMap(){} // no Leaflet / OSM fetches

function vCatalogBody(){
 const all=vClinicList(),pageCount=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(all.length/5));dirUI.page=Math.min(dirUI.page,pageCount);
 const selected=all.slice((dirUI.page-1)*5,dirUI.page*5);
 const matches=all.slice(0,5);
 return `${dirUI.filters?`<section class="vx-filter-workspace" aria-label="Фильтрация и предварительный просмотр клиник">
 <div class="vx-ref-filter">${vFilterPanel()}</div>
 <div class="vx-ref-matches"><label class="vx-inline-search">${svg('search')}<input id="vx-mini-search" type="search" placeholder="Поиск" aria-label="Поиск по списку клиник" value="${esc(state.q)}"></label><div class="vx-match-list">${matches.map(c=>`<label class="vx-match-item"><input type="checkbox" data-vx-check="${esc(c.id)}" ${dirUI.compare.has(c.id)?'checked':''}><span><strong>${esc(c.name)}</strong><small><a href="${clinicHref(c)}">${esc(c.address)}</a></small><small>${esc(c.hours)}</small></span></label>`).join('')||'<p>Клиники не найдены</p>'}</div></div>
 ${dirUI.map?`<div class="vx-ref-map">${vStaticMap()}</div>`:''}</section>`:''}
 <section class="vx-full-results" aria-label="Список клиник и свободные окна"><div class="vx-results-head"><h2>Найдено ${all.length} клиник</h2></div>
 ${selected.length?selected.map(vCatalogCard).join(''):empty('Клиники не найдены','Измените фильтры или запрос.',false)}
 ${vPager(dirUI.page,pageCount)}</section>`;
}
function vCategoryTiles(selected='all'){
 return `<div class="v-category-tiles">${categoryList.filter(([id])=>id!=='all').map(([id,label])=>`<button class="v-cat-tile ${selected===id?'selected':''}" data-action="v-service-cat" data-category="${id}" aria-pressed="${selected===id}"><span class="v-cat-icon">${categoryImage(id)}</span><strong>${esc(label)}</strong></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
}
function vServiceRecords(cat){
 const rows=[];
 for(const c of publicClinics())for(const s of c.services){if(cat!=='all'&&s.category!==cat)continue;if(state.q&&!normalize(s.title+' '+c.name+' '+catName(s.category)).includes(normalize(state.q)))continue;rows.push({c,s});}
 return rows.sort((a,b)=>serviceUI.sort==='price'?a.s.price-b.s.price:serviceUI.sort==='clinic'?a.c.name.localeCompare(b.c.name,'ru'):a.s.title.localeCompare(b.s.title,'ru'));
}
function vServiceAccordion(cat,label){
 const rows=vServiceRecords(cat),expanded=serviceUI.open===cat;
 const perPage=24,total=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(rows.length/perPage));serviceUI.page=Math.min(total,serviceUI.page);
 const slice=rows.slice((serviceUI.page-1)*perPage,serviceUI.page*perPage);
 return `<section id="v-service-${esc(cat)}" class="v-service-accordion ${expanded?'expanded':''}"><button type="button" class="v-service-acc-heading" data-action="v-service-accordion" data-category="${esc(cat)}" aria-expanded="${expanded}">${svg('down')}<strong>${esc(cat==='therapy'?'Приёмы специалистов':label)}</strong><span>${rows.length.toLocaleString('ru-RU')}</span></button>
 ${expanded?`<div class="v-service-accordion-body"><div class="v-service-two-col">${slice.length?slice.map(({c,s})=>`<button class="v-service-price-row vx-service-row" data-action="book" data-id="${esc(c.id)}" data-service="${esc(s.id)}" title="${esc(s.title)} — ${esc(c.name)}" aria-label="${esc(s.title)} в ${esc(c.name)}, ${money(s.price)}"><span class="vx-row-title">${esc(s.title)}<small>${esc(c.name)}</small></span><strong>${money(s.price)}</strong></button>`).join(''):'<p class="v-no-services">По выбранным условиям услуг нет.</p>'}</div>${vPager(serviceUI.page,total,'v-service-page')}</div>`:''}</section>`;
}
function vDoctorCard(d){

 return `<article class="v-doctor-card vx-doctor-card"><div class="v-doctor-photo"><img src="${esc(asset(d.image))}" alt="Портрет ${esc(d.name)}" loading="lazy"><span>Стаж ${d.experience} лет</span></div><div class="v-doctor-info"><h2>${esc(d.name)}</h2><p class="v-doctor-job">${esc(d.title)}</p><p class="vx-doctor-bio">${esc(d.description||'Ветеринарный специалист')}</p><p class="v-info-line">${svg('clock')} <span>Ближайшее время: ${available||'по запросу'}</span></p><p class="v-info-line">${vetoraIcon('clinic','v-small-img')} <a href="${clinicHref(c)}">${esc(c.name)}</a></p></div><div class="v-doctor-cta"><button class="btn" data-action="doctor" data-id="${d.id}">О враче</button><button class="btn primary" data-action="v-doctor-book" data-id="${d.id}">Выбрать время</button></div></article>`;
}
function clinicListPage(){
 return `<div class="v-directory vx-directory-page"><div class="page-title v-title"><h1>Клиники Москвы и области</h1></div>
 ${vSearchRow('clinics')}
 <div class="v-filter-chips"><button class="v-chip vx-filter-icon ${dirUI.filters?'active':''}" data-action="v-filter-expand" aria-label="${dirUI.filters?'Скрыть':'Показать'} фильтры">${vetoraIcon('action_controls','v-chip-icon')}</button><button class="v-chip" data-action="v-filter-focus" data-target="v-filter-type">Тип клиники ${svg('down')}</button><button class="v-chip" data-action="v-filter-focus" data-target="v-filter-metro">Метро ${svg('down')}</button><button class="v-chip ${dirUI.openNow?'active':''}" data-action="v-toggle-open">Открыто сейчас</button><button class="v-chip ${dirUI.map?'active':''}" data-action="v-toggle-map">${vetoraIcon('map','v-chip-icon')} На карте</button>${dirUI.compare.size?`<button class="v-chip active" data-action="v-compare-open">Сравнить (${dirUI.compare.size})</button>`:''}</div>

function doctorSpecialties(d){return (d.categories||[]).slice(0,2).map(id=>`<span class="doctor-specialty">${medicalIcon(id,'doctor-category-icon')}${catName(id)}</span>`).join('');}
function doctorCard(d){return `<article class="doctor-card"><img src="${esc(asset(d.image))}" alt="Портрет: ${esc(d.name)}" loading="lazy"><h2>${esc(d.name)}</h2><div class="doctor-specialties">${doctorSpecialties(d)}</div><p class="doctor-role">${esc(d.title)}</p><p class="doctor-desc">${esc(d.description)}</p><button class="btn" data-action="doctor" data-id="${d.id}">Подробнее ${svg('arrow')}</button></article>`;}
function matchingDoctors(){return doctors.filter(d=>{const c=clinics.find(c=>c.id===d.clinicId);return c&&(state.region==='all'||(state.region==='mo'?c.area==='mo':c.area!=='mo'))&&(state.category==='all'||d.categories.includes(state.category))&&(!state.q||normalize(d.name+' '+d.title+' '+d.categories.map(catName).join(' ')+' '+c.name).includes(normalize(state.q)));});}

// V24 - Directory doctor cards matching Container reference, separate from clinic-detail cards.
const v24BannerImage = 'data:image/webp;base64,';
function v24ClinicFor(d){return clinics.find(c=>c.id===d.clinicId);}
function v24ServiceFor(d,c){return c?.services?.find(s=>d.categories?.includes(s.category)&&/приём|консультац/i.test(s.title))||c?.services?.find(s=>d.categories?.includes(s.category))||c?.services?.[0];}
function v24HomeService(c){return c?.services?.find(s=>/на дому|на дом|выезд/i.test(s.title));}
function v24Schedule(d){
 if(!doctorUI.schedules[d.id]){
  let day=0;
  if(doctorUI.date==='tomorrow')day=1;
  if(doctorUI.date==='weekend'){let dow=formDay(0).getDay();day=(6-dow+7)%7;}
  if(doctorUI.date==='any'){
   const clinic=v24ClinicFor(d);
   if(clinic&&!demoSlots(clinic,day).length){
    const first=[1,2,3,4,5,6].find(offset=>demoSlots(clinic,offset).length);
    if(first!==undefined)day=first;
   }
  }
  doctorUI.schedules[d.id]={week:Math.floor(day/6)*6,day};
 }
 return doctorUI.schedules[d.id];
}
function v24DoctorCard(d){
 const c=v24ClinicFor(d);if(!c)return '';
 const schedule=v24Schedule(d),service=v24ServiceFor(d,c),homeService=v24HomeService(c);
 const visit=doctorUI.visitModes[d.id]||'clinic';
 const offsets=Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>schedule.week+i);
 const day=offsets.includes(schedule.day)?schedule.day:schedule.week;
 const month=formDay(day).toLocaleDateString('ru-RU',{month:'long'});
 const slots=demoSlots(c,day);
 const typePrice=service?money(service.price):'По запросу';
 const clinicPhone=c.phone||'';
 return `<article class="v24-doctor-card v25-doctor-card" data-v24-doctor="${esc(d.id)}">
  <div class="v24-doctor-left"><img class="v24-doctor-photo" src="${esc(asset(d.image))}" alt="Портрет ${esc(d.name)}" loading="eager"><p>Тип приёма</p>
   <div class="v24-visit-options"><button type="button" class="v24-visit ${visit==='clinic'?'active':''}" data-action="v24-visit" data-id="${esc(d.id)}" data-mode="clinic" aria-pressed="${visit==='clinic'}">В клинике · ${typePrice}</button>
   <button type="button" class="v24-visit ${visit==='home'?'active':''}" data-action="v24-visit" data-id="${esc(d.id)}" data-mode="home" aria-pressed="${visit==='home'}">На дому · ${homeService?money(homeService.price):'по запросу'}</button></div>
  </div>
  <div class="v24-doctor-info"><h3><button class="v24-name-link" data-action="doctor" data-id="${esc(d.id)}">${esc(d.name)}</button></h3>
   <p class="v24-doctor-specialty">${esc(d.title)}</p>
   <p class="v24-doctor-bio"><strong>Стаж ${Number(d.experience)||1} лет</strong> · ${esc(d.description||'Приём животных по предварительной записи.')}</p>
   <p class="v24-doctor-rating"><span><span class="v26-rating-star" aria-hidden="true">★</span> ${v25RatingText(c)} · демо</span><span class="v25-feedback-pill">${v25RatingReviews(c)} отзывов · демо</span></p>
   <p class="v24-info-label">Телефон для записи</p>
   <p class="v24-doctor-contact">${svg('phone')} <a href="tel:${esc(clinicPhone.replace(/[^+\d]/g,''))}">${esc(clinicPhone||'Уточнить в клинике')}</a></p>
   <p class="v24-doctor-contact">${svg('pin')} <a href="${clinicHref(c)}">${esc(c.address)}</a></p>
   <ul class="v24-address-metro"><li>${esc(c.location||'Москва')}</li></ul>
   <p class="v24-doctor-contact v24-work-hours">${svg('clock')} ${esc(c.hours||'Время работы уточняйте')}</p>
  </div>
  <div class="v24-doctor-scheduler"><div class="v24-date-head"><strong>Дата приёма</strong><div class="v24-week-nav" role="group" aria-label="Недели приёма">
  <button class="prev" type="button" data-action="v24-week" data-id="${esc(d.id)}" data-dir="-1" aria-label="Предыдущие шесть дней" ${schedule.week===0?'disabled':''}>${svg('arrow')}</button><span>${esc(month)}</span>
  <button class="next" type="button" data-action="v24-week" data-id="${esc(d.id)}" data-dir="1" aria-label="Следующие шесть дней" ${schedule.week>=354?'disabled':''}>${svg('arrow')}</button></div></div>
  <div class="v24-doctor-days">${offsets.map(offset=>{const dt=formDay(offset);return `<button type="button" class="${offset===day?'selected':''}" data-action="v24-day" data-id="${esc(d.id)}" data-day="${offset}" aria-pressed="${offset===day}"><small>${esc(weekdays[dt.getDay()])}</small>${dt.getDate()}</button>`}).join('')}</div>
  <div class="v24-doctor-times">${slots.length?slots.map(t=>`<button type="button" data-action="v24-slot" data-id="${esc(d.id)}" data-day="${day}" data-time="${esc(t)}" aria-label="${esc(d.name)}, ${esc(isoDay(day))}, ${esc(t)}">${esc(t)}</button>`).join(''):'<span class="v24-no-times">На выбранную дату нет времени</span>'}</div>
  </div></article>`;
}
function v24DoctorReplaceCard(id){
 const d=doctors.find(x=>x.id===id);const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-v24-doctor]')].find(e=>e.dataset.v24Doctor===id);
 if(d&&el)el.outerHTML=v24DoctorCard(d);
}
function v24DoctorList(){
 let list=matchingDoctors().filter(d=>{
  const c=v24ClinicFor(d); if(!c)return false;
  if(doctorUI.clinic!=='all'&&d.clinicId!==doctorUI.clinic)return false;
  if(state.area!=='all'&&c.area!==state.area)return false;
  if(doctorUI.metro!=='all'&&c.location!==doctorUI.metro)return false;
  if(doctorUI.near&&c.area==='mo')return false;
  if(doctorUI.home&&!v24HomeService(c))return false;
  if(doctorUI.date!=='any'){
   let date=doctorUI.date==='today'?0:doctorUI.date==='tomorrow'?1:(6-formDay(0).getDay()+7)%7;
   if(!demoSlots(c,date).length)return false;
  }
  if(doctorUI.urgency==='today'&&!demoSlots(c,0).length)return false;
  if(doctorUI.urgency==='tomorrow'&&!demoSlots(c,1).length)return false;
  return true;
 });
 if(doctorUI.sort==='experience')list.sort((a,b)=>(b.experience||0)-(a.experience||0));
 if(doctorUI.sort==='price')list.sort((a,b)=>(v24ServiceFor(a,v24ClinicFor(a))?.price||999999)-(v24ServiceFor(b,v24ClinicFor(b))?.price||999999));
 if(doctorUI.sort==='soon')list.sort((a,b)=>(demoSlots(v24ClinicFor(b),0).length)-(demoSlots(v24ClinicFor(a),0).length));
 return list;
}
function doctorsPage(){
 const list=v24DoctorList(),per=6,total=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(list.length/per));doctorUI.page=Math.max(1,Math.min(doctorUI.page,total));
 const locations=[...new Set(clinics.map(c=>c.location).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'ru'));
 return `<div class="v-directory vx-doctors-page v24-doctors">
  <h1 class="v24-title">Врачи и специалисты</h1>
  <section class="v24-ask-banner"><div class="v24-ask-content"><h2>Задайте вопрос ветеринару</h2><p>Опишите ситуацию с питомцем и подготовьте обращение к специалисту. Выберите клинику для ответа.</p><button class="btn primary" type="button" data-action="v24-ask">Опишите ситуацию</button></div><img class="v24-ask-image" src="${v24BannerImage}" alt="Ветеринар с собакой в современной клинике"></section>
  <form id="directory-search" class="v24-search-row" role="search"><label class="field-shell">${svg('search')}<span class="sr-only">Поиск клиники, услуги или врача</span><input id="doctor-query" type="search" placeholder="Найти клинику, услугу или врача" autocomplete="off" value="${esc(state.q)}"></label><label class="v24-search-select"><span class="sr-only">Район Москвы</span><select id="v24-doctor-area">${opts(areas,state.area)}</select></label><button class="btn primary" type="submit">Найти</button></form>
  <section class="v25-filter-panel" aria-label="Фильтры врачей">
   <div class="v25-filter-heading"><div><strong>Подобрать специалиста</strong><span>Уточните параметры поиска</span></div><button type="button" class="v25-reset" data-action="v24-clear">Сбросить фильтры</button></div>
   <div class="v25-filter-grid">
    <label><span>Специализация</span><select id="vx-doctor-specialization">${opts([['all','Все специальности'],...categoryList.filter(([id])=>id!=='all')],state.category)}</select></label>
    <label><span>Дата приёма</span><select id="v24-date-filter">${opts([['any','Любая дата'],['today','Сегодня'],['tomorrow','Завтра'],['weekend','В выходные']],doctorUI.date)}</select></label>
    <label><span>Срочность</span><select id="v24-urgency-filter">${opts([['any','Не важно'],['today','Сегодня'],['tomorrow','До завтра']],doctorUI.urgency)}</select></label>
    <label><span>Метро / район</span><select id="v24-metro-filter">${opts([['all','Любое метро'],...locations.map(v=>[v,v])],doctorUI.metro)}</select></label>
    <label><span>Клиника</span><select id="v-doctor-clinic">${opts([['all','Все клиники'],...clinics.map(c=>[c.id,c.name])],doctorUI.clinic)}</select></label>
    <label><span>Сортировать</span><select id="v24-sort">${opts([['popular','По популярности'],['experience','По стажу'],['price','По стоимости'],['soon','По ближайшему приёму']],doctorUI.sort)}</select></label>
   </div>
   <div class="v25-filter-bottom"><button type="button" class="v25-toggle" data-action="v24-near" aria-pressed="${doctorUI.near}">${svg('pin')} Рядом</button><button type="button" class="v25-toggle" data-action="v24-home" aria-pressed="${doctorUI.home}">${svg('home')} Выезд на дом</button><span class="v25-filter-count">Показано специалистов: ${list.length}</span></div>
  </section>
  <section class="v24-results"><div class="v24-doc-summary"><h2>Врачи <span>${list.length}</span></h2></div>
  <div class="v24-list">${list.slice((doctorUI.page-1)*per,doctorUI.page*per).map(v24DoctorCard).join('')||empty('Не нашли специалистов','Попробуйте изменить параметры поиска.',false)}</div>
  ${vPager(doctorUI.page,total,'v-doctor-page')}</section>
  </div>`;
}

 <section class="vx-clinic-info vx-block"><div class="vx-section-heading"><h2>Основная информация</h2><button data-action="v-report-error">${svg('external')} Сообщить об ошибке</button></div>
 <div class="vx-trust-line"><span class="vx-green">★ ${v25RatingText(c)} · демо</span><span>Информация о клинике</span><span class="vx-status"><strong>Профиль клиники</strong><small>Информация и контакты</small></span><span class="vx-status"><strong>Подбор по услугам</strong><small>Специализации и направления</small></span><span class="vx-status"><strong>Сведения</strong><small>Адрес, режим работы, контакты</small></span><span class="vx-status"><strong>Запись</strong><small>Выбор удобного времени</small></span></div>
 <div class="vx-facts-grid"><div class="vx-fact"><h3>${svg('pin')} Адрес</h3><p>${esc(c.address)}</p><small>${esc(c.location||'Метро уточняется')}</small></div><div class="vx-fact"><h3>${svg('clock')} Режим работы</h3><p>${esc(c.hours)}</p><small>Расписание уточните перед визитом</small></div><div class="vx-fact"><h3>${vetoraIcon('phone','v-small-img')} Контакты</h3>${c.phone?`<p><a href="tel:${c.phone.replace(/[^+\d]/g,'')}">${esc(c.phone)}</a></p>`:'<p>Контакты уточняются</p>'}${c.url?`<p><a href="${esc(c.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Сайт клиники</a></p>`:''}</div><div class="vx-fact"><h3>${svg('calendar')} Приём</h3><p>Первичный приём — от ${money(price.price)}</p><small>В одно посещение · без подтверждения</small></div></div></section>
 ${vClinicBookingPanel(c)}
 <section id="vx-clinic-doctors" class="vx-block vx-clinic-team"><div class="vx-section-heading"><h2>Врачи</h2></div><div class="vx-doctor-filters"><label><span class="sr-only">Специальность врача</span><select id="vx-clinic-doctor-filter">${opts([['all','Все специальности'],...categoryList.filter(([id])=>id!=='all')],detailUI.doctorCat||'all')}</select></label><label><span class="sr-only">Стаж</span><select id="vx-clinic-experience">${opts([['all','Стаж'],['5','От 5 лет'],['10','От 10 лет']],detailUI.expFilter||'all')}</select></label><span>Выход на день</span></div><div class="vx-clinic-doctors-grid">${(team.length?team:doctors.slice(0,8)).filter(d=>(!detailUI.doctorCat||detailUI.doctorCat==='all'||d.categories.includes(detailUI.doctorCat))&&(!detailUI.expFilter||detailUI.expFilter==='all'||d.experience>=+detailUI.expFilter)).slice(0,8).map(vDoctorCard).join('')||'<p>Нет врачей по выбранным условиям.</p>'}</div></section>
 <section id="vx-clinic-services" class="vx-block vx-clinic-services"><div class="vx-section-heading"><h2>Услуги и цены</h2></div><div class="v-service-accordions">${clinicServices.map(([id,label])=>{const items=c.services.filter(s=>s.category===id),open=(detailUI.clinicAcc||clinicServices[0]?.[0])===id;return `<div class="v-service-accordion ${open?'expanded':''}"><button class="v-service-acc-heading" data-action="vx-clinic-service-acc" data-category="${id}" aria-expanded="${open}">${svg('down')}<strong>${esc(id==='therapy'?'Приёмы специалистов':label)}</strong><span>${items.length}</span></button>${open?`<div class="v-service-accordion-body"><div class="v-service-two-col">${[...items,...items,...items].slice(0,24).map(s=>`<button class="v-service-price-row vx-service-row" data-action="v-clinic-service" data-service="${esc(s.id)}"><span class="vx-row-title">${esc(s.title)}</span><strong>${money(s.price)}</strong></button>`).join('')}</div></div>`:''}</div>`;}).join('')}</div></section>
 <section id="vx-clinic-reviews" class="vx-block vx-reviews"><div class="vx-section-heading"><h2>Отзывы <span class="vx-count">${c.isDemo?'560 · демо':'Отзывы пока не подключены'}</span></h2><button class="btn primary" data-action="v-demo-review">Оставить отзыв</button></div><div class="vx-review-score">★ <strong>${v25RatingText(c)}</strong> <span>Рейтинг-пример: демонстрационные отзывы</span></div><div class="vx-review-tabs">${['Кошелек','Вакцинация','Хирургия','Возрастные животные','Срочные случаи','Пожилые питомцы','Персонал'].map((s,i)=>`<button data-action="vx-review-tab" data-index="${i}" class="${(vx.reviewTab||'2')===String(i)?'active':''}">${s}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="vx-review-list">${Array.from({length:5},(_,i)=>`<div class="vx-review-row"><aside>Пример отзыва <span class="vx-green">★ ${v25RatingText(c)} · демо</span><small>14 августа</small></aside><p>Демонстрационный текст отзыва, показывающий формат обсуждения лечения, общения с персоналом и прозрачности стоимости. Реальные отзывы клиникой и Vetora не подтверждены.</p></div>`).join('')}</div></section>
 <section id="vx-clinic-trust" class="vx-block vx-trust"><div class="vx-section-heading"><h2>Доказательство по похожим случаям</h2></div><div class="vx-review-tabs">${['Кошелек','Вакцинация','Хирургия','Возрастные животные','Срочные случаи','Пожилые питомцы','Персонал'].map((s,i)=>`<button data-action="vx-trust-tab" data-index="${i}" class="${(vx.trustTab||'2')===String(i)?'active':''}">${s}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="vx-trust-body"><div class="vx-gauge"><strong>84</strong><small>Индекс доверия</small></div><div class="vx-trust-bars">${[['Объяснение назначений',54],['Очередь по записи',78],['Прозрачность цены',68],['Прозрачность цены',36],['Прозрачность цены',56]].map(([l,v])=>`<div><strong>${l}</strong><div><span style="width:${v}%"></span></div><small>${v}% · демо</small></div>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="vx-trust-foot"></div></section>
 </div>`;
}

function about(){return `${breadcrumb('О сервисе')}<div class="page-title"><h1>Забота без лишних шагов</h1></div><div class="about-copy"><h2>Как выбрать клинику</h2><p>1. Подтверждение записи осуществляется выбранной клиникой.</p><h2>Информация об услугах</h2><p>Адреса и сведения о восьми клиниках представлены по открытым источникам; четыре дополнительные клиники, их фотографии и цены являются демонстрационными.
