Окончательную стоимость и состав услуги уточняйте перед посещением.</p><h2>Личный кабинет</h2><p>Сохраняйте избранные клиники и выбирайте направления помощи для питомца.</p><button class="btn primary" data-action="register">Создать аккаунт</button></div>`;}
function render(){renderHeader();renderFooter();$('#main').innerHTML=({home,search:searchResultsPage,clinics:clinicListPage,services:servicesPage,doctors:doctorsPage,clinic:clinicDetail,favorites:favoritesPage,map:mapPage,about}[state.page]||home)();if(state.page==='clinics')updateClinics();document.title='Vetora — '+({home:'ветеринарная помощь рядом',search:'поиск ветеринарной помощи',clinics:'выбрать клинику',services:'услуги и цены',doctors:'специалисты',clinic:clinics.find(c=>c.id===state.clinic)?.name||'клиника',favorites:'избранное',map:'клиники на карте',about:'как записаться'}[state.page]);}
function closeDialogIfOpen(){if($('#dialog').open)closeDialog();}
function toast(text){clearTimeout(toastTimer);$('#toast').textContent=text;$('#toast').classList.add('visible');toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('#toast').classList.remove('visible'),2600);}
function openDialog(html){const d=$('#dialog');if(!d.open)trigger=document.activeElement;d.innerHTML=html;document.body.classList.add('modal-open');if(!d.open)d.showModal();setTimeout(()=>{const f=d.querySelector('[autofocus]')||d.querySelector('.close');f?.focus();},0);}
function closeDialog(){const d=$('#dialog');d.close();document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');if(trigger?.isConnected)trigger.focus({preventScroll:true});else $('#main').focus({preventScroll:true});trigger=null;}
const dialogHead=title=>`<div class="dialog-head"><h2 id="dialog-title">${title}</h2><button class="close" data-action="close" aria-label="Закрыть окно">${svg('close')}</button></div>`;
function regionDialog(){openDialog(`<div class="dialog-content">${dialogHead('Где искать помощь?')}<p>Покажем клиники выбранного региона.</p><div class="region-options">${[['all','Москва и область'],['moscow','Москва'],['mo','Московская область']].map(([id,label])=>`<button class="btn white" data-action="set-region" data-region="${id}" ${state.region===id?'aria-current="true"':''}>${label}${state.region===id?svg('check'):svg('arrow')}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`);}
function auth(mode='login'){openDialog(`<div class="auth-visual"><img src="${asset('assets/auth-pets-generated.png')}" alt="">${brand()}</div><div class="dialog-content">${dialogHead(mode==='register'?'Зарегистрироваться':'Рады вас видеть')}<p>${mode==='register'?'Питомцы, клиники и записи — в одном месте.':'Войдите, чтобы видеть своих питомцев и записи.'}</p><div class="info-panel">Код для входа появится на следующем шаге. SMS не требуется.</div><form id="auth-form" data-mode="${mode}" novalidate>${mode==='register'?'<label for="auth-name">Как к вам обращаться</label><input id="auth-name" name="name" autocomplete="off" maxlength="60" placeholder="Например, Анна">':''}<label for="auth-phone">Номер телефона</label><input id="auth-phone" name="phone" type="tel" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="off" placeholder="+7 (999) 123-45-67" aria-describedby="auth-error" autofocus required><div class="error" id="auth-error" role="alert"></div><button class="btn primary wide" type="submit">Продолжить ${svg('arrow')}</button></form><button class="dialog-switch" data-action="${mode==='register'?'login':'register'}">${mode==='register'?'Уже есть аккаунт? Войти':'Нет аккаунта? Зарегистрироваться'}</button></div>`);}
function demoCode(mode){$('#dialog').innerHTML=`<div class="dialog-content">${dialogHead('Проверка кода')}<p>Введите код <strong>000000</strong>, чтобы продолжить.</p><form id="code-form" data-mode="${mode}" novalidate><label for="auth-code">Код подтверждения</label><input id="auth-code" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" pattern="[0-9]{6}" maxlength="6" placeholder="000000" aria-describedby="code-error" required><div id="code-error" class="error" role="alert"></div><button class="btn primary wide" type="submit">${mode==='register'?'Продолжить':'Войти'}</button></form><button class="dialog-switch" data-action="${mode==='register'?'register':'login'}">Вернуться к номеру</button></div>`;$('#auth-code').focus();}
function account(){
 const sorted=[...appointments].sort((a,b)=>(a.date+'T'+a.time).localeCompare(b.date+'T'+b.time));
 const cards=sorted.map(a=>{const c=clinics.find(c=>c.id===a.clinicId),service=c?.services.find(s=>s.id===a.serviceId);
 const dateLabel=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(a.date)?a.date.split('-').reverse().join('.'):a.date;
 return `<article class="saved-appointment"><div><strong>${esc(c?.name||a.clinicName||'Клиника')}</strong><small>${esc(dateLabel)} · ${esc(a.time)} · ${esc(a.pet)}</small>${service?`<small>${esc(service.title)}</small>`:''}<small class="status-note">Не подтверждена клиникой</small></div><button class="btn" data-action="remove-appointment" data-id="${esc(a.id)}" aria-label="Удалить запись">Удалить</button></article>`;}).join('');
 openDialog(`<div class="dialog-content">${dialogHead('Мои записи')}${sorted.length?`<p>Запланированные посещения</p><div class="saved-appointments">${cards}</div>`:`<p>У вас пока нет добавленных записей.</p>`}<p class="small muted">Записи хранятся в этом браузере и не являются подтверждёнными бронированиями клиники.</p><button class="btn primary wide" data-action="browse">Найти клинику</button>${state.demoSession?`<button class="dialog-switch" data-action="logout">Выйти</button>`:''}</div>`);
}
function doctorDialog(id){const d=doctors.find(d=>d.id===id);if(!d)return;const c=clinics.find(c=>c.id===d.clinicId);openDialog(`<div class="dialog-content doctor-dialog">${dialogHead(esc(d.name))}<div class="doctor-dialog-identity"><img class="doctor-portrait" src="${esc(asset(d.image))}" alt="Иллюстративный портрет врача" width="104" height="104"><div class="doctor-dialog-profile"><h3>${esc(d.title)}</h3>${doctorSpecialties(d)}<p>Условный стаж: ${d.experience} лет</p></div></div><div class="doctor-dialog-bio"><h3>Направления работы</h3><p>${esc(d.description)}</p></div><a class="btn white wide" href="${clinicHref(c)}">${esc(c.name)}</a><button class="btn primary wide" data-action="v-doctor-book" data-id="${d.id}">Выбрать время ${svg('arrow')}</button></div>`);}
function book(id,serviceId='',doctorId=''){
 const c=clinics.find(c=>c.id===id);if(!c)return;
 const doc=doctors.find(d=>d.id===doctorId&&d.clinicId===id);
 const service=c.services.find(s=>s.id===serviceId);
 openDialog(`<div class="dialog-content">${dialogHead('Добавить запись')}<p>Выберите дату и время посещения.</p>
 <div class="summary-row"><span>Клиника</span><strong>${esc(c.name)}</strong></div>
 <div class="summary-row"><span>Адрес</span><strong>${esc(c.address)}</strong></div>
 ${doc?`<div class="summary-row"><span>Специалист</span><strong>${esc(doc.name)}</strong></div>`:''}
 <form id="booking-form" data-clinic="${esc(c.id)}" data-doctor="${esc(doc?.id||'')}" novalidate>
 ${service?`<div class="summary-row"><span>Услуга</span><strong>${esc(service.title)}</strong></div><input type="hidden" name="service" value="${esc(service.id)}">`:`<label for="booking-service">Услуга</label><select id="booking-service" name="service"><option value="">Выбрать позже</option>${c.services.map(s=>`<option value="${esc(s.id)}">${esc(s.title)} · ${money(s.price)}</option>`).join('')}</select>`}
 <label for="booking-pet">Кличка питомца</label><input id="booking-pet" name="pet" type="text" maxlength="80" placeholder="Например, Барсик" autocomplete="off" required>
 <div class="booking-fields"><div><label for="booking-date">Дата посещения</label><input id="booking-date" name="date" type="date" required></div><div><label for="booking-time">Время</label><input id="booking-time" name="time" type="time" step="900" required></div></div>
 <div id="booking-error" class="error" role="alert" aria-live="polite"></div>
 <button class="btn primary wide" type="submit">Добавить запись</button>
 </form>
 <a class="btn white wide" href="tel:${c.phone.replace(/[^+\d]/g,'')}">Позвонить ${esc(c.phone)}</a>
 <p class="small muted" style="margin:12px 0 0">Запись сохранится в вашем списке, но не будет отправлена в клинику автоматически.</p></div>`);
 const date=$('#booking-date'),now=new Date();
 if(date)date.min=[now.getFullYear(),String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')].join('-');
}
function reset(){route(state.page==='home'?'home':state.page,{q:'',category:'all',area:'all',network:'all',sort:'default',service:''});}
function updateQuery(value,inputId){state.q=value;if(state.page==='clinics'){const focused=document.activeElement?.id;const cursor=document.activeElement?.selectionStart??value.length;dirUI.page=1;updateClinics();const next=document.getElementById(focused);if(next){next.focus({preventScroll:true});try{next.setSelectionRange(cursor,cursor);}catch{}}}else{const input=$('#'+inputId),pos=input.selectionStart;$('#main').innerHTML=state.page==='services'?servicesPage():doctorsPage();const next=$('#'+inputId);next.focus();next.setSelectionRange(pos,pos);}const p=new URLSearchParams(location.hash.split('?')[1]||'');if(value)p.set('q',value);else p.delete('q');history.replaceState(null,'','#'+state.page+(p.size?'?'+p:''));}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const skip=e.target.closest('.skip');if(skip){e.preventDefault();$('#main').focus({preventScroll:true});$('#main').scrollIntoView();return;}const link=e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]:not([data-action])');if(link){const href=link.getAttribute('href');if(/^#(home|clinics|doctors|services|favorites|map|about|clinic)(?:\?|$)/.test(href)&&state.region!=='all'&&!new URLSearchParams(href.split('?')[1]||'').has('region')){e.preventDefault();location.hash=href+(href.includes('?')?'&':'?')+'region='+encodeURIComponent(state.region);return;}}const suggestion=e.target.closest('[data-suggest-kind]');if(suggestion){e.preventDefault();selectSuggestion(suggestion);return;}
 const chosenArea=e.target.closest('[data-area-select]');if(chosenArea){e.preventDefault();setSearchArea(chosenArea.dataset.areaSelect);return;}
 if(e.target.closest('#hero-area-button')){e.preventDefault();toggleAreaList();return;}
 if(!e.target.closest('.smart-search'))closeSearchPanels();
 const button=e.target.closest('[data-action]');if(!button)return;e.preventDefault();const {action,id,category,service,network,doctor,region,kind}=button.dataset;
 if(action==='v-filter-expand'){dirUI.filters=!dirUI.filters;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicListPage();updateClinics();return;}
  if(action==='v-filter-focus'){if(!dirUI.filters){dirUI.filters=true;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicListPage();updateClinics();}const target=document.getElementById(button.dataset.target);target?.focus({preventScroll:false});return;}
 if(action==='v-open-clinic-doctors'||action==='v-open-clinic-services'){detailUI.clinicAcc='therapy';route('clinic',{clinic:id});requestAnimationFrame(()=>document.getElementById(action==='v-open-clinic-doctors'?'vx-clinic-doctors':'vx-clinic-services')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}));return;}
 if(action==='vx-clinic-service-acc'){detailUI.clinicAcc=detailUI.clinicAcc===category?'':category;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicDetail();document.getElementById('vx-clinic-services')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return;}
 if(action==='vx-review-tab'){vx.reviewTab=button.dataset.index;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicDetail();document.getElementById('vx-clinic-reviews')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return;}
 if(action==='vx-trust-tab'){vx.trustTab=button.dataset.index;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicDetail();document.getElementById('vx-clinic-trust')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return;}
 if(action==='v-demo-review'||action==='v-report-error'){toast('Демонстрационный экран. Отправка данных не подключена.');return;}
 if(action==='v-apply-service-search'){serviceUI.open='therapy';$('#main').innerHTML=servicesPage();return;}
 if(action==='vx-booking-see'){document.getElementById('vx-clinic-booking')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return;}
 if(action==='v-toggle-map'){dirUI.map=!dirUI.map;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicListPage();updateClinics();return;}
 if(action==='v-toggle-open'){dirUI.openNow=!dirUI.openNow;dirUI.page=1;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicListPage();return;}
 if(action==='v-filter-apply'){dirUI.page=1;updateClinics();return;}
 if(action==='v-filter-clear'){dirUI.openNow=false;dirUI.daySlots=false;dirUI.onlyDemo=false;dirUI.category='all';dirUI.clinicType='all';dirUI.metro='all';dirUI.sort='default';dirUI.page=1;route('clinics',{q:'',area:'all',network:'all',category:'all',service:''});return;}
 if(action==='v-page'){dirUI.page=Number(button.dataset.page)||1;updateClinics();$('#v-catalog-content')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});return;}
 if(action==='v-compare'){if(dirUI.compare.has(id))dirUI.compare.delete(id);else if(dirUI.compare.size<3)dirUI.compare.add(id);else {toast('Можно сравнить до трёх клиник');return;}$('#main').innerHTML=clinicListPage();return;}
 if(action==='v-compare-open'){const selected=[...dirUI.compare].map(i=>clinics.find(c=>c.id===i)).filter(Boolean);openDialog(`<div class="dialog-content">${dialogHead('Сравнение клиник')}<p>Сравнение ориентировочных параметров. Не является медицинской рекомендацией.</p><div class="v-compare-grid">${selected.map(c=>`<div><img src="${esc(asset(c.image))}" alt=""><h3>${esc(c.name)}</h3><p>${esc(c.address)}</p><p>${esc(c.hours)}</p><p>Услуг: ${c.services.length}</p><p>Приём: от ${money(clinicPrice(c).price)}</p><p>${c.isDemo?'Демо-клиника':'Информация из справочника'}</p><a class="btn" href="${clinicHref(c)}">Открыть клинику</a></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`);return;}
 if(action==='v-week-next'||action==='v-week-prev'){
  const change=action==='v-week-next'?6:-6;
  const compact=button.dataset.compact==='1';
  if(compact){dirUI.weekStart=Math.max(0,Math.min(360,dirUI.weekStart+change));dirUI.day=dirUI.weekStart;updateClinics();}
  else{detailUI.weekStart=Math.max(0,Math.min(360,detailUI.weekStart+change));detailUI.selectedDay=detailUI.weekStart;vRefreshClinicBooking();}
  return;
 }
 if(action==='v-clinic-date'){
  const offset=Number(button.dataset.offset)||0;
  if(button.dataset.compact==='1'){dirUI.day=offset;updateClinics();}
  else{detailUI.selectedDay=offset;vRefreshClinicBooking();}
  return;
 }
 if(action==='v-clinic-slot'){const sid=detailUI.serviceByClinic[id]||state.service||clinics.find(c=>c.id===id)?.services[0]?.id;book(id,sid);const date=$('#booking-date'),time=$('#booking-time');if(date)date.value=button.dataset.date;if(time)time.value=button.dataset.time;return;}
 if(action==='v-gallery'&&button.dataset.index==='8'){
  const c=clinics.find(x=>x.id===state.clinic);
  const allPhotos=c?.id==='vd-tailhelp'?refGallery:(c?.photos||[c?.image,'assets/vetora17/clinic-reception.webp','assets/vetora17/clinic-examination.webp','assets/vetora17/clinic-pets.webp','assets/vetora17/clinic-garden.webp','assets/original-14.jpg','assets/original-20.jpg','assets/original-3.webp','assets/original-16.jpg'].filter(Boolean));
  openDialog(`<div class="dialog-content v17-gallery-modal">${dialogHead('Фотографии клиники · демо')}
   <p>Иллюстративные изображения для прототипа. Не являются фотографиями реальной организации.</p>
   <div class="v17-gallery-grid">${allPhotos.map((src,i)=>`<button data-action="v17-gallery-photo" data-index="${i}" aria-label="Фотография ${i+1}"><img src="${esc(asset(src))}" alt="Иллюстративная фотография ${i+1}" loading="lazy"></button>`).join('')}</div></div>`);
  return;
 }
 if(action==='v17-gallery-photo'){detailUI.photo=Number(button.dataset.index)||0;closeDialog();$('#main').innerHTML=clinicDetail();return;}
 if(action==='v-gallery'){detailUI.photo=Number(button.dataset.index)||0;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicDetail();return;}
 if(action==='v-detail-tab'){document.getElementById('vx-clinic-'+button.dataset.tab)?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});return;}
 if(action==='v-show-booking'){document.getElementById('vx-clinic-booking')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});return;}
 if(action==='v-month-next'){detailUI.weekStart=Math.min(360,detailUI.weekStart+6);detailUI.selectedDay=detailUI.weekStart;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicDetail();return;}
 if(action==='v-month-prev'){detailUI.weekStart=Math.max(0,detailUI.weekStart-6);detailUI.selectedDay=detailUI.weekStart;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicDetail();return;}
 if(action==='v-clinic-service'){detailUI.serviceByClinic[state.clinic]=service;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicDetail();document.getElementById('vx-clinic-booking')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});return;}
 if(action==='v-doctor-specialty'){doctorUI.page=1;route('doctors',{category,q:''});return;}
 
 if(action==='v24-week'){
  const v=doctorUI.schedules[id]||{week:0,day:0},change=Number(button.dataset.dir)||1;
  v.week=Math.min(354,Math.max(0,v.week+change*6));v.day=v.week;doctorUI.schedules[id]=v;v24DoctorReplaceCard(id);return;
 }
 if(action==='v24-day'){
  const v=doctorUI.schedules[id]||{week:0,day:0};v.day=Number(button.dataset.day)||0;doctorUI.schedules[id]=v;v24DoctorReplaceCard(id);return;
 }
 if(action==='v24-visit'){
  doctorUI.visitModes[id]=button.dataset.mode==='home'?'home':'clinic';v24DoctorReplaceCard(id);return;
 }
 if(action==='v24-slot'){
  const d=doctors.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!d)return;
  const c=v24ClinicFor(d);const home=v24HomeService(c);
  const isHome=doctorUI.visitModes[id]==='home';
  if(isHome&&!home){toast('Выезд врача необходимо уточнить в клинике.');return;}
  const service=isHome?home:v24ServiceFor(d,c);
  book(c.id,service?.id||'',d.id);
  const date=$('#booking-date'),time=$('#booking-time');
  if(date)date.value=isoDay(Number(button.dataset.day)||0);
  if(time)time.value=button.dataset.time||'';
  return;
 }
 if(action==='v24-near'){doctorUI.near=!doctorUI.near;doctorUI.page=1;$('#main').innerHTML=doctorsPage();return;}
 if(action==='v24-home'){doctorUI.home=!doctorUI.home;doctorUI.page=1;$('#main').innerHTML=doctorsPage();return;}
 if(action==='v24-clear'){
  Object.assign(doctorUI,{page:1,clinic:'all',sort:'popular',date:'any',urgency:'any',metro:'all',near:false,home:false,schedules:{},visitModes:{}});
  state.q='';state.category='all';state.area='all';$('#main').innerHTML=doctorsPage();return;
 }
 if(action==='v24-ask'){
  openDialog(`<div class="dialog-content">${dialogHead('Задайте вопрос ветеринару')}<p>Расскажите о симптомах и выберите клинику. В прототипе текст сохраняется только в браузере и не отправляется специалисту.</p>
   <form id="v24-question-form"><label for="v24-question-text">Что случилось с питомцем?</label><textarea id="v24-question-text" rows="5" required maxlength="2500" placeholder="Опишите симптомы, возраст питомца и когда это началось" style="width:100%;border:1px solid #d6e2f0;border-radius:11px;padding:12px;font:inherit;resize:vertical"></textarea><label for="v24-question-clinic">Клиника для обращения</label><select id="v24-question-clinic">${clinics.map(c=>`<option value="${esc(c.id)}">${esc(c.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select><button type="submit" class="btn primary wide">Сохранить обращение</button></form></div>`);
  return;
 }
 
 if(action==='v-doctor-page'){doctorUI.page=Number(button.dataset.page)||1;$('#main').innerHTML=doctorsPage();$('.v24-doc-summary')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});return;}
 if(action==='v-doctor-book'){const d=doctors.find(x=>x.id===id);if(d){closeDialogIfOpen();book(d.clinicId,'',d.id);}return;}
 if(action==='v-service-cat'){serviceUI.open=category;serviceUI.page=1;$('#main').innerHTML=servicesPage();document.getElementById('v-service-'+category)?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});return;}
 if(action==='v-service-accordion'){serviceUI.open=serviceUI.open===category?'':category;serviceUI.page=1;$('#main').innerHTML=servicesPage();return;}
 if(action==='v-service-page'){serviceUI.page=Number(button.dataset.page)||1;$('#main').innerHTML=servicesPage();$('.v-service-accordions')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});return;}
 if(action==='search-clear'){const input=$('#hero-query');if(input){input.value='';input.focus();showSearchSuggestions();}}
 else if(action==='search-category'){if(kind==='clinic')route('clinics',{q:state.q,area:state.area,category:'all',service:'',network:'all'});else if(kind==='doctor')route('doctors',{q:state.q,category:'all',area:'all'});else if(kind==='service')route('services',{q:state.q,category:'all'});else if(kind==='specialty')route('doctors',{q:'',category:'all'});}
 else if(action==='close')closeDialog();else if(action==='region')regionDialog();else if(action==='set-region'){closeDialog();state.homeLimit=6;state.mapClinic='';route(state.page,{region,area:'all',q:'',network:'all',category:'all',service:''});}
 else if(action==='login'||action==='register')auth(action);else if(action==='account')account();else if(action==='logout'){state.demoSession=false;closeDialog();renderHeader();toast('Вы вышли из аккаунта');}else if(action==='browse'){closeDialog();route('clinics',{q:'',category:'all',service:''});}else if(action==='remove-appointment'){appointments=appointments.filter(a=>a.id!==id);persistAppointments();account();toast('Запись удалена');}
 else if(action==='favorite'){if(favorites.has(id))favorites.delete(id);else favorites.add(id);try{localStorage.setItem('vetora-v2-favorites',JSON.stringify([...favorites]));}catch{}const saved=favorites.has(id);button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(saved));button.setAttribute('aria-label',(saved?'Убрать из избранного: ':'Добавить в избранное: ')+clinics.find(c=>c.id===id)?.name);toast(saved?'Клиника добавлена в избранное':'Клиника удалена из избранного');if(state.page==='favorites'){$('#main').innerHTML=favoritesPage();$('#main').focus({preventScroll:true});}}
 else if(action==='more'){state.homeLimit=clinics.length;const top=window.scrollY;$('#main').innerHTML=home();window.scrollTo(0,top);const cards=$$('#home-clinics .clinic-card');cards[6]?.querySelector('a')?.focus({preventScroll:true});}
 else if(action==='specialists')route('doctors',{category,q:'',service:'',network:'all',area:'all'});
 else if(action==='direction')route(['dermatology','cardiology','ophthalmology','neurology','oncology','orthopedics'].includes(category)?'doctors':'services',{category,q:'',service:'',network:'all'});
 else if(action==='category')route(state.page,{category,service:'',network:'all'});
 else if(action==='service')route('clinics',{service,category,q:'',network:network||'all',area:'all'});
 else if(action==='reset')reset();else if(action==='doctor')doctorDialog(id);else if(action==='book')book(id,service,doctor);
});
document.addEventListener('submit',e=>{const form=e.target;
 if(form.id==='v24-question-form'){
  e.preventDefault();const message=$('#v24-question-text')?.value.trim();
  if(!message){$('#v24-question-text')?.focus();return;}
  try{localStorage.setItem('vetora-draft-vet-question',JSON.stringify({text:message,clinicId:$('#v24-question-clinic')?.value,savedAt:new Date().toISOString()}));}catch{}
  closeDialog();toast('Черновик обращения сохранён только в вашем браузере.');return;
 }
 if(form.id==='directory-search'){e.preventDefault();state.q=form.querySelector('input[type=search]')?.value.trim()||'';if(state.page==='clinics'){state.area=$('#filter-area')?.value||'all';dirUI.page=1;updateClinics();}else if(state.page==='doctors'){$('#main').innerHTML=doctorsPage();}return;}if(form.id==='hero-search'){e.preventDefault();const q=$('#hero-query').value.trim(),area=$('#hero-area').value;closeSearchPanels();route('search',{q,area,category:'all',service:'',network:'all'});}else if(form.id==='booking-form'){
 e.preventDefault();const clinic=clinics.find(c=>c.id===form.dataset.clinic);
 const pet=form.querySelector('[name="pet"]')?.value.trim();
 const date=form.querySelector('[name="date"]')?.value;
 const time=form.querySelector('[name="time"]')?.value;
 const serviceId=form.querySelector('[name="service"]')?.value||'';
 const msg=$('#booking-error');
 if(!clinic||!pet||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date||'')||!/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(time||'')){
   msg.textContent='Заполните кличку питомца, дату и время.';return;
 }
 const at=new Date(date+'T'+time);
 if(!Number.isFinite(at.getTime())||at.getTime()<=Date.now()){
   msg.textContent='Укажите будущую дату и время.';return;
 }
 const record={id:'a-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8),clinicId:clinic.id,clinicName:clinic.name,doctorId:form.dataset.doctor||'',serviceId,pet,date,time,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()};
 appointments.unshift(record);
 if(!persistAppointments()){appointments.shift();msg.textContent='Не получилось сохранить запись в браузере. Проверьте настройки хранения данных.';return;}
 account();toast('Запись добавлена в ваш список');
 }else if(form.id==='auth-form'){e.preventDefault();const input=$('#auth-phone'),digits=input.value.replace(/\D/g,'');const valid=/^[78]\d{10}$/.test(digits);if(!valid){$('#auth-error').textContent='Введите номер в формате +7 (999) 123-45-67.';input.setAttribute('aria-invalid','true');input.focus();return;}demoCode(form.dataset.mode);}else if(form.id==='code-form'){e.preventDefault();if($('#auth-code').value!=='000000'){$('#code-error').textContent='Введите код 000000.';$('#auth-code').setAttribute('aria-invalid','true');$('#auth-code').focus();return;}state.demoSession=true;closeDialog();renderHeader();toast('Добро пожаловать в Vetora');account();}});
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.id==='hero-query')showSearchSuggestions();if(e.target.id==='catalog-query'||e.target.id==='service-query'||e.target.id==='doctor-query'||e.target.id==='vx-mini-search')updateQuery(e.target.value,e.target.id==='vx-mini-search'?'catalog-query':e.target.id);if(e.target.id==='auth-phone'){e.target.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');$('#auth-error').textContent='';}if(e.target.id==='auth-code'){e.target.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');$('#code-error').textContent='';}});
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{const id=e.target.id;
 
 if(id==='v25-map-clinic-filter'){dirUI.focusMapClinic=e.target.value;const panel=document.querySelector('.vx-ref-map');if(panel)panel.innerHTML=vStaticMap();return;}
 if(state.page==='doctors'&&['v24-sort','v24-date-filter','v24-urgency-filter','v24-metro-filter','v24-doctor-area'].includes(id)){
  const key={'v24-sort':'sort','v24-date-filter':'date','v24-urgency-filter':'urgency','v24-metro-filter':'metro'}[id];
  if(id==='v24-doctor-area')state.area=e.target.value;else doctorUI[key]=e.target.value;
  doctorUI.page=1;doctorUI.schedules={};$('#main').innerHTML=doctorsPage();return;
 }
 
 if(e.target.matches('[data-vx-check]')){const x=e.target.dataset.vxCheck;if(e.target.checked){if(dirUI.compare.size>=3){e.target.checked=false;toast('Можно сравнить до трёх клиник');return;}dirUI.compare.add(x);}else dirUI.compare.delete(x);$('#main').innerHTML=clinicListPage();return;}
 if(e.target.matches('[data-v-slot-category]')){
  const c=clinics.find(c=>c.id===e.target.dataset.vSlotCategory);
  const match=c?.services.find(s=>s.category===e.target.value);
  if(match){detailUI.serviceByClinic[c.id]=match.id;if(state.page==='clinic')vRefreshClinicBooking();else updateClinics();}
  return;
 }
 if(id==='vx-booking-category'){
  const c=clinics.find(c=>c.id===state.clinic)||clinics.find(c=>c.id==='vd-tailhelp')||clinics[0];
  const match=c?.services.find(s=>s.category===e.target.value);
  if(match){detailUI.serviceByClinic[c.id]=match.id;vRefreshClinicBooking();}
  return;
 }
 if(id==='vx-clinic-doctor-filter'){detailUI.doctorCat=e.target.value;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicDetail();document.getElementById('vx-clinic-doctors')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return;}
 if(id==='vx-clinic-experience'){detailUI.expFilter=e.target.value;$('#main').innerHTML=clinicDetail();document.getElementById('vx-clinic-doctors')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return;}
 if(id==='vx-doctor-specialization'){doctorUI.page=1;route('doctors',{category:e.target.value});return;}
if(id==='v-doctor-clinic'){doctorUI.clinic=e.target.value;doctorUI.page=1;$('#main').innerHTML=doctorsPage();return;}
 if(id==='v-filter-type'){dirUI.clinicType=e.target.value;dirUI.page=1;updateClinics();return;}
 if(id==='v-filter-metro'){dirUI.metro=e.target.value;dirUI.page=1;updateClinics();return;}
 if(id==='v-filter-category'){dirUI.category=e.target.value;dirUI.page=1;updateClinics();return;}
 if(id==='v-dir-sort'){dirUI.sort=e.target.value;dirUI.page=1;updateClinics();return;}
 if(id==='v-service-sort'){serviceUI.sort=e.target.value;serviceUI.page=1;$('#main').innerHTML=servicesPage();return;}
 if(e.target.matches('[data-v-slot-service]')){
  const c=clinics.find(c=>c.id===e.target.dataset.vSlotService);
  if(c?.services.some(s=>s.id===e.target.value)){
   detailUI.serviceByClinic[c.id]=e.target.value;
   if(state.page==='clinic')vRefreshClinicBooking();else updateClinics();
  }
  return;
 }
 if(['v-open-now','v-day-slots','v-only-demo'].includes(id)){dirUI[{'v-open-now':'openNow','v-day-slots':'daySlots','v-only-demo':'onlyDemo'}[id]]=e.target.checked;dirUI.page=1;updateClinics();return;}
 if(id==='home-category'){focusAfterRoute=id;state.homeLimit=6;route('home',{category:e.target.value,q:'',service:'',area:'all',network:'all'});}else if(id==='filter-area'||id==='filter-network'||id==='filter-sort'){focusAfterRoute=id;const key={'filter-area':'area','filter-network':'network','filter-sort':'sort'}[id];route(state.page,{[key]:e.target.value});}else if(id==='map-select'){state.mapClinic=e.target.value;$('#map-content').innerHTML=mapMarkup(state.page==='map');}});
document.addEventListener('focusin',e=>{if(e.target.id==='hero-query')showSearchSuggestions();});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
 if(e.target.id==='hero-query'){
  if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();if(!searchOpen)showSearchSuggestions();activateSearchOption(activeSearchOption+(e.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1));}
  else if(e.key==='Enter'&&searchOpen&&activeSearchOption>=0){e.preventDefault();selectSuggestion(searchOptionList()[activeSearchOption]);}
  else if(e.key==='Escape'&&searchOpen){e.preventDefault();closeSearchPanels();}
 }else if(e.target.id==='hero-area-button'){
  if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();toggleAreaList(true);$('#hero-area-list [role="option"]')?.focus();}
  else if(e.key==='Escape')toggleAreaList(false);
 }else if(e.target.matches('#hero-area-list [role="option"]')){
  if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();toggleAreaList(false);$('#hero-area-button')?.focus();}
  else if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();const a=$$('#hero-area-list [role="option"]'),idx=a.indexOf(e.target);a[(idx+(e.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)+a.length)%a.length]?.focus();}
 }
});
$('#dialog').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key!=='Tab')return;const controls=$$('a[href],button:not([disabled]),input:not([disabled]),select:not([disabled]),[tabindex="0"]',$('#dialog')).filter(el=>el.getClientRects().length);const first=controls[0],last=controls[controls.length-1];if(!first){e.preventDefault();return;}if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}});
$('#dialog').addEventListener('cancel',e=>{e.preventDefault();closeDialog();});$('#dialog').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===$('#dialog')){const r=e.target.getBoundingClientRect();if(e.clientX<r.left||e.clientX>r.right||e.clientY<r.top||e.clientY>r.bottom)closeDialog();}});
// Links inside a modal should close it before hash navigation.
$('#dialog').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]'))closeDialog();});
window.addEventListener('hashchange',readRoute);readRoute();
window.VETORA_ITERATION={version:18,iconLibrary:134,iconSystem:'Vetora Soft 3D v2',mode:'standalone with local appointment list',doctorProfiles:'fictional-demo',clinics:clinics.length,doctors:doctors.length,getState:()=>({...state,favorites:[...favorites]}),navigate:route};
})();
